text: Downgraded from 5 stars to 1. I've been playing this game from its launch, 8 years ago. Just as I was thinking their unannounced changes couldn't get any worse, they did. You now only receive 10 coins (plus a few more if you have any moves or boosters left) to complete a level - down from 50! For those who have never played, to buy just 5 extra moves to complete a level costs 900 coins! It was already extremely difficult. Playrix, you are losing many long-term players. I guess you don't care

Fun, until it's impossible to beat levels without spending coins. I also play Homescapes, and the best part about that game vs. this game, is when there's a level that is impossibly hard, and you keep trying to beat the level over and over, eventually the level gets easier to help you beat it. Gardenscapes does NOT do this. I have played the same level over 20 times, using all the power ups, and only spending coins on several life refills, and still can't beat the levels. Not fun.

All the latest and new changes RUINED this game. I have been playing this game for YEARS and spent A LOT OF MONEY to support the game. Now, not only the payout gone to nothing when you win a level (it was so much higher when I started. For example, when you win an easy level, you use to get 75 to 80+coins. That number went down to half, and now it's 10 or so. They also changed one of the powerups, which was dynamite with rainbow blast to just dynamite. I'm way cutting back playing this game.

This game is no longer fun. As you go up levels, you feel pressured to buy power ups. Even the $.99 pack gets expensive after a while. It's so ridiculous! The new power ups are so lame too. There's a difference between challenging games and ones that make you stressed. They use addictive tactics to keep playing. I am close to uninstalling the game, even though I spent money throughout the time.

After 19,000+ levels, I'm giving up playing. This game has steadily gotten worse. From gameplay that requires boosters to win a level, to "easy" levels that are anything but, to erosion of boosters, - the latest being a reduction of starter boosters - the devs have enshittified what was a once fun game. It's now boring, frustrating, and unrewarding. I don't plan to return to gameplay and I definitely do not recommend this game at this point. Save your time and your money.

I really enjoyed this game for years, but recently the changes to game have made me decide to stop playing. Every incentive in the game has been reduced, and it most definitely has become pay to play. I don't mind spending money on a game, but no more with this one. Giving certain players added bonuses and excluding others is ridiculous. Don't even get me started on the STUPID side games or the impossible scavenger hunt, HATE THE CHANGES!! DO BETTER PLAYRIX!!

Quite good. This is the only game I've always come back to. I've had it for years now and still play it. *update in 2026. Recent changes to gameplay (complete revamp of game) are terrible. The power-ups, the texture, and the animations. All the extras, (bird hatching, cards, etc) are annoying, but most of all I hate having Austin face in the corner, emoting. Yuck! I will probably delete the game since all the changes have me avoiding the game instead of playing. Sad to go.

I've played this game for years and the past few months the makers of the game have done anything they can to make money. They have reduced bonuses, power-ups, and when you fail to pass the level they intentionally place buttons and time them so that you accidentally push on them to spend your coins without intending to. And now the every other level is so difficult to pass that you spend days stuck, because they hope you get frustrated enough to just spend your money.

Game starts out fun then quickly becomes much less enjoyable. Once you hit level 100 about every second to every fourth level is either hard, super hard or one shot. You run out of the boosters to help you very quickly and they're very slow to replenish. It's very aggravating. I honestly don't know how much longer I'm going to put up with this before I uninstall the game and I'm definitely not spending real money on it. Having a hard level every once in a while is okay but this is ridiculous.

Edit: Based off latest reviews, I've gifted the property to Austin and the town and am uninstalling this App. Ad watching simulator. Ads appear even when you have option to decline for a bonus, so screwed either way. Excruciatingly slow progression. Cute Storyline, but the amount of 30 second Ads is torture and the puzzles are setup to profit on them at the expense of pleasure.

I echo the comments from other long time players, the bonus structure and coins awarded from each level have decreased so notably over time, it makes game play less fun and it makes it harder to advance levels (which is what they want of course, to make $ when you have to buy moves or bonus items to beat levels). There used to be 2 bombs and the dynamite sticks used to come with a one of those things that looks like a CD. I'm just going to stop playing, it's not worth it any more.

I've played this game for years and have loved it UNTIL THIS LATEST UPDATE! It's ridiculous. They reduced the power ups, reduced rewards for completing tasks, made everything harder to complete, treasure hunts are harder and take an absurd amount of energy, and made it harder to pass levels. All in an effort to make you spend literal money to be able to progress in the game. So frustrating and disappointing.

ok I like this game a lot, and it is it's actually what they say it is! However, I HATE how there is usually a EXTREMELY hard level that is SUPER HARD TO BEAT and after a few tries, you run out of life's and won't get more until 25 min later! what the heck?! Their other game, Township is WAY better, with easier levels and more customization for your buildings

The latest updates make this a '1-star' game. The developers decided to make significant in-game shifts that clearly made powerups/tools significantly worse and levels increasingly harder. The only logical reason is a money grab. Levels have become exceptionally more challenging to the point they are not passable without significant luck, powerups and gold. I have spent a significant amount of time and money on this game. Unfortunately it is no longer fun, and feels a lot more like work.

You've ruined the games! I've been playing Gardenscapes and Homescapes for years. Every time you make an update to the game, it gets worse. Playing the games used to be fun to do in my spare time but it gets less fun every time you make an update. The cards are a stupid addition because it takes forever to get them all. Most of the challenges are impossible to finish unless you spend a lot of money or play 24/7. I'm just about finished playing both of them. You've really ruined the games for me.

money grab. dont waste your time playing. the game is good dont get me wrong. but the developers dont care about the players at all not like other games that reward players with daily check ins. plus when reaching some levels its obvious they want you to spend money cause they make it so difficult to win. the stage will only have like 5 - 10 moves but you have to collect 130 pieces of 2 different colored items with so little space on the board. thats just them forcing you to spend money.

Love the game, but special items have changed and suck now. Moles are gone because people had too much of a challenge. They have modified to the lowest common denominator. Okay to play when you have nothing else to do, but not as good as before. Also seems to be money grab, we have team players that buy the pass all the time, that shouldn't be necessary.

do not install this game. it used to be so fun, I've been playing for about 15 yrs now but I'm tired of being cheated and customer service does nothing! when I first started playing you got up to 300 coins per level you beat, now they give minimum of 10 coins and maximum of a little over 100 but you have to beat a super hard level. this is so they can get you to purchase more coins, which you must do if you want to get out of a level that's impossible to beat unless you spend 900 for 5 more move

I used to love this game but these past few months, it's been acting weird. It's turning into pay-to-win. I've been stuck on a hard level (which is fine because it happens) but I used all power ups to clear the level - it only gave me one bomb, one rainbow and one dynamite. What in the actual hell happened to the second bomb and the rainbow that comes with the dynamite power up??? I'm done with this game.

Editing 1 star to 3 since "no more moves" was added. When "continue game" was removed, I was robbed of over 20k coins due to accidental touch. I'm still mad about it. The removal of the restoration side game and accumulated holiday decor is still disappointing. I'm not a fan of the new side games and the removal of the glove that swapped pieces, but the catch when you run out of moves is a huge improvement.

This game gets greedier with every update. They are constantly reducing the opportunities to earn power ups in game, taking away the best power ups completely, and reducing the time certain earned power ups are active. Coupled with the 'random' levels that more often than not are almost impossible to win without either coins or power ups. This used to be a fun game. If you're not already invested, go find a less money hungry game to play.

How long does it take y'all to respond when someone submits a "I made an in app purchase and only got part of the bundle I bought" queries? It's been over a week. I spend too much money in this game to let it slide; but I'm saving money in the long wait. ******* It takes 2 weeks, and repeatedly filling out forms through the game. Then they just assure you that you definitely weren't shorted on a purchase, bc Their info shows that your purchase was completed, even when it wasn't. FF: REPEAT 07/26

I have been playing this game for years. Used to be fun but now has become a money grab. I don't mind spending on a game I enjoy since there are no ads. Understand they need money to continue putting out the game. Now feel like they force you to buy all the time. Levels have become so hard to pass and boosters most of the time are put where they do the least amount of good. Will be uninstalling.

Game partially stopped working somewhere after level 500. I'm so sad! I can play the garden portion but the adventure side keeps racking up energy and there's a location icon to tap to continue the story, but nothing happens when I tap it. if it doesn't work soon, I'm going to delete it, which sucks but it is so limiting, it's not worth it. Hoping someone sees this and fixes it.

Horrible game. They just recently changed the RNG (random number generator) of the game and made it almost impossible to play or pass any levels without having to pay real cash. I've been a long time player of this game and have enjoyed it over the years. But, I refuse to put any more money into this game and I would highly recommend others to avoid this. Do not play this game. They will immediately lure you to reaching into your wallet.

this used to be a 5 star game but every time they do an update they take more away. the safe gave 5000 coins for 2.99 now its 3000, for completing a regular difficulty level you'd get at least 50 coins and now they've taken the rainbow blast out of the third poweup but it still cost the same and the customer service is terrible. I've been trying to reach them for days because the game crashed but says I failed a level and I lost my streak that was over 1000.

Had this game on my phone for at least 8 years now. It has definitely changed since I started playing. I noticed that they started giving you less moves to pass the higher levels. Although the game is still challenging they really need to be more generous with the amount of moves you're able to make on one level. It would be great if you give you more stars as well, since it takes between 500 to 700 stars to restore one area in the garden.

BEWARE. As a long time player, they have systematically downgraded everything. All the bonuses have items taken away, as well as a change in boosters (ex: no more horizontal/vertical booster; it's now one or the other). In this new world we seem to be living in, greed is more important than loyalty. I'm out - uninstalling.

This game is messed up. I used to think it was my old phone. Got a brand new phone and same issues. There is a problem with the top of the screen. Even when there is a suggested move, half the time it doesn't work. Also, when you make a five bomb move, half the time you get a small rocket. CS...not good either. Also, it was a relaxing game to play. Once you get past a certain point it is no longer relaxing. You can stuck on levels for weeks on end. Its sad loyal=worse game play

Game has potential - but it gets old never being able to make it past 2 world with 5 lives. Then it takes 30 mins per life to refill. I want a game i can actually play for more than 15 mins every almost 3 hours. It is clear this game is making so you can't progress much without spending money. Kinda lame. I'm all for giving to games i like, but not games that require such. Tried this game again after a few years. They've added a bunch of useless side games, and otherwise nothing has changed

I've been playing this game since it first came out and have put in a lot of money buying the season tickets almost every time a new one comes out. It's extremely disappointing that they keep changing the game for the worse to prevent high level players from advancing without paying. I am not putting any more money into this game and I highly recommend that you don't even install it!!! the game is designed to not let you advance unless you pay. Don't get suckered in!

love the game but anymore all I get is hard or super hard levels. Can take weeks to get through them. Really really tired of the excessive hard levels. Don't get to enjoy the game as much because of them. I guess your really not interested in what we think. Almost every other level is hard or super hard. I think I'll find a game I can enjoy. Have played for a long time but now to get anywhere you have to use up all the bonuses and buy more. Bye

When I first started playing I would have rated this a five, but now the super hard levels have gotten almost impossible to beat unless you spend money on coins. I understand the game has to make money and I will gladly watch ads, but the challenges should be achievable. I also love the side quests but I've been unable to complete any so far because you run out of energy so quickly. This game is just no longer fun.

Greedy and Predatory. When you make moves and run out, the option to buy more pops up and there’s no delay or confirmation so you hit it, and it robs you of 500 coins. 900 coins are hard to get because winning levels or finding them only give you about 10 at a time. The sticker packs are smaller and offer you lower stars, so you find it harder to get the ones you need. The one shots are super hard and will make you lose all your bombs. It used to be a great game when it started.

Went to play this morning and found an error stating An error occurred. PlayGames on PC was reset because of an error. Your progress was saved, but you'll have to download your games again. But progress was not saved, game started from the beginning. This is the THIRD time this has happened of having to start over, been playing for years so lost the high level I was at. This also affected Homescapes, an June's Journey. Lost all progress and have to start over with ALL of them.

It's definitely addicting. I wish it wasn't so hard to get thru the levels though. And there's not a way to talk back to the butler. He's funny though. I've sat here just watching him and laughed at his comments and the dog. UPDATED: so once you get past level 2000, the harder levels become SO ridiculous that you are forced into making purchases just to be able to advance. The level of fun has greatly diminished, and I don't have an endless supply of money to continue to play. Deleting app.

I love this game! I could spent hours playing. However, it is expensive for an older game. I played years ago and stopped due to the money it took to play rather than be stuck on a level forever. My suggestion to the creators is to create an affordable membership for their fans that would just let them play. The game itself is entertaining, challenging, and adventurous. Truly on3 of the best games out there, and I play a lot...just expensive.

I have been playing this game for years and recently hit level 10,000. I used to enjoy this game more than any other, but it has gotten to the point that it's impossible to beat the harder levels without boosters!! Keep in mind that the prices have went up and also you now get less for your money. Don't play this game if you can't spend a fortune on it! I've been on the same level for 6 days now!! Play Cookie Jam! You get lots of FREE play and boosters EVERY day!!! No money needed !

The game was fun at first. Then became a pay to win style game. The levels that are super hard are just that... Super hard in less u have money to spend on the game. I don't agree with some of the levels being situational style levels. Meaning u have to make bombs or double rainbows to break boxes u aren't able to reach. Lastly they just did an update changing the power-ups. I can't say everyone but most of the people on her were happy with the old power-ups. It's just another money grab

Been playing for quite some time. Game has become more difficult to succeed and less enjoyable. The incentives to spend $$ are a waste. Bonus items during game are less and less, making it less attractive to play and win. At one time, was willing to recommend creator of game but now recommend other provider of games.

Loved this game to kill time I have been playing for years. I didn't even mind spending the $10 a month for power packages. Once it upgraded the ability to succeed in the game downgraded. To even win easy levels takes so many boosters it's getting costly. Most of us aren't comfortable shelling out hundreds of dollars on a game. Be more realistic with your levels and coin distribution.

harder to get the bonuses and the bonuses have been seriously nerfed. it is now set up so that you almost need to pay to play. don't get me wrong it is still free but you're going to stall out and replay the same level a LOT before advancing and they aren't giving you as many personalization options in the expansions. sort of disappointing.

This game sucks. It randomly takes my rainbow blast unexpectedly. I stop playing for a few, and when I come back, it's gone. It's frustrating. And whoever decides the difficulty level for the game levels needs to be fired. I've played easy levels that are harder that challenge levels and vice-versa.

My son and I used to love this game when we started playing years ago. It keeps changing and becoming more of a blatant grab for money. The "new" graphics are childish, levels incredibly difficult to beat without paying money, and the old challenges with cool upgrades for seasons, holidays etc. are completely gone. Please bring back the old designers, or hire someone better. Coupled with these ridiculously difficult levels, we're ready to throw in the towel :/

this game just continuously gets worse. less coins, less boosters, less energy points. Quests are beyond unrealistic to complete unless you spend actual money on the game and even then, I still couldn't and haven't completed a quest since all the new downgrades. everything in gardenscapes now is a nerf bonus. everything you need is less obtainable and less valuable if obtained so basically the entire game is less than it used to be.

would not recommend unless you want to spend all your hard earned money on this app. once you reach a certain point it will never let you pass a level unless you spend money. been stuck on the same level for hours unless I spend money to buy coins to continue or buy power ups to help finish the level. either way you have to spend money to win and I refuse so I'll never progress any further than where I am so eventually I'll have to Uninstall it because I'm stuck.

I've been playing this game for several years now and it's not even a shadow of what it used to be. I used to love the game but they have gradually taken away a majority of the perks in the game. They try to force you to buy stuff by making levels extremely difficult to beat, even the "easy" ones. On rare occasion I would pay for packages until they doubled what they charge. They've also gradually taken away/reduced the quality/quantity of in-game power-ups. It's no fun anymore. Do not support!

This game is a money grab, RIDICULOUS PRICES and very minimal reward.  Also, the game frequently gliches (I believe this is done purposefully to cost the player coin & LOTS OF THEM.  Way too many advertisements on top of costing a fortune to compete.  With every upgrade the game becomes less player friendly.  There’s something very shady going on here.  I am uninstalling this after years of playing, it’s gone way too far and there are too many GREAT GAMES out there that won’t bust the bank.

I have been playing this game for a while. I'm embarrassed to admit it, but I've played for years. I have always enjoyed this game and appreciated the way it adapted and changed. The recent updates have made me stop playing. The upgrades and items to help you pass levels have changed and are not as good; they barely help you pass levels, if at all. The updates are constant and make gameplay annoying and make me want to play less and less. I'm not mad, just... disappointed.

Interesting puzzles, but that's it. The game is all about microtransactions. When you reach certain level, it becomes a struggle to move on, because some levels are purposely designed to be unbeatable without powerups and extra moves. Now, I know developers need to earn their share and I actually paid a few times for some goodies, but it feels like they go out so quickly, it's like you need to buy them again every second day, and they are not cheap.

Great game with no ads. However, it is designed to be addictive and leads to levels where you will have to spend money to beat it! Addicting because there are easy bonuses which leads to hours of free play, which is phsycologically manipulative and dangerous. Beginning in level 233, there is a requirement to collect butterfly pieces. The problem is that they give you less pieces and not enough chances to get them. I deleted then . 14 turns but they do not give you 14 pieces in those turns

Been playing this since 2020 . However this new map with no collections is a waste of time, like the terrible merging thing, it's time consuming for little reward. Also please bring back the one hour half energy usage every day. It was a bonus. I think challenge levels should be optional. Working hard for super rainbow then losing it on a challenge you probably won't pass is soul destroying. Needs tweaking slightly but please listen to your players!

I think it's going to take many more bad ratings before they change this game back for the better. Like many others, I'm just sick of all the negative changes. The coin rewards are ridiculous, among many others. It's always "our games are winnable". Well playing days on one level isn't fun. So your reply about this is just stupid. Anyway. 2 stars. I've had it.

Used to really love this game. Progression is almost impossible even when you're spending money. It's impossible to finish the events. You can try and do a level 50 times and still not pass it. I used to be able to get through a fair few levels at once especially with boosters/timed booster rewards. They make absolutely no difference now. If you're not willing to spend money you'll be stuck on a level for weeks and weeks. I've played for years, spent a lot of money. You've ruined it.

Starts off addictively, but the greedy programmers make it so that you cannot progress after a certain point without paying, which comes very soon. The "candy crush" part takes up most of the game, and it makes it impossible for you to progress, unless you pay, of course. Pity, could have been a good game. Uninstalled.

Imagine being stuck at 1 level for 5 days unless you pay. That's what the game is all about. Pay to win, or lose all your combos, coins, and everything you earned. You will anyway. It was bad a few years ago with a wicked algorithm, now they implemented unbeatable AI that will ruin all you strategies and combos forcing you to lose or pay! I paid a couple of time but it's never enough for the devs. They implemented the AI to never back off on forcing a payment. Uninstalling.

Well, I have uninstalled for the last time. I love the game buuuuut a game is suppose to be fun and not stressfull and frustrating! I can not play for more than a few minutes and either the game freezes, crashes or screen is blotchy. I have to log out and back in numerous times in minutes, that is frustrating and stressfull! THAT IS NOT FUN.

Game is good, I find it fun at first but most of the time, the levels are too hard to win, and it's quite depressing to be stuck on one level after trying several times. Without coins and boosters, you will be stuck in hard, super hard and challenging levels. Maybe more opportunities to get free coins can help. And give more chances of winning than losing the levels to make it a fun and not depressing game at times.

Let me start by saying that if you want to "build your own garden" its just not going to happen anymore. Used to allow you to pick a lot of customization for the items but not anymore. Its frustrating as the stars take a while to gather only for me to not be able to pick my own decor. The game just picks for you, especially in the later areas. Don't even get me started on how I have to click out of 5 popups at a time to even start playing. Its lost all its charm and it keeps pushing you to spend

edit: as of 29.06.26, there has been issue after issue. firstly, our chats stop, that's ok, It's a UK thing. Now we can't play without our data being on and still says not conneced if we do have it on! it use to be a lovely game. not anymore. Great. But the 900 coins for an extra 5 moves is a bit silly. Winning coins at the end of a level is less like 50-65 coins.... then taking 900 coins for an extra 5 moves is a bit harsh.

This game is really nice, but the levels are way too hard. You are given only a few moves, yet you need to finish so many objectives just to clear the stage. I’ve been playing for years and I play fairly no cheating at all. But it’s disappointing that I often have to spend a lot of money just to pass a single level. I hope the developers will listen: please make the levels more reasonable. Don’t make it too difficult for loyal, honest players like me. It feels unfair and exhausting.

I agree with many of the other players...some levels are too hard to get through! Not enough coins as I will never spend money on here! update Jun 2026: the administrators have taken away so many items in this game in the last few weeks. I am ready to delete. I have been playing this game for over 10 years. Only get a single bomb now, no blaster with the med dynamite. The adventure zone is boring. Only collect nuts and bolts. Out of hits after 3. This will be an all paid game next update I bet

Update (June 2026). these devs are getting more and more greedy. I've been playing for nearly 10 years and at the verge of uninstalling. I echo what all other 1 star reviews are saying. Update (Aug 2024): festival ticket was just $4 and the latest is $13. That's an insane increase. I will not be making anymore purchases. Used to love this game. I just noticed that the prices for the coin packs have increased. I will not be making any more purchases for this game. Very sneaky and greedy.

Used to be a fun relaxing game, but it's become too overwhelming. So many events and in-game games, the screen is filled with buttons and popups are endless... The interface lags until all the animations are finished. What killed it for me is having to see a character face with exaggerated emotions during the actual 3 in a row play experience, I'm not sure it's such a problem for anyone else but I just can't stand it. But I played for free and didn't find it that impossible as others write.

I have been playing this game for over 10 years , I would normally give it a 5 star review , BUT for the last week when I open the game and start playing all of a sudden with no warning it just shuts down ,which has made me lose rewards and progress!! very very frustrating and basically makes the game unplayable!!!! VERY DISAPPOINTING😞

Changing my review from a 5 to a 1. Haf so much fun playing this game for YEARS, but the recent updates and changes SUCK. They made the power ups weaker!! So instead the offered 2 boms or the bomb and dynamite combos you could've chosen from ahead of the game, now you can only get one bomb or a single dynamite. During the game there use to be a hand that you could use, they took that away as well, so all the power ups that could've helped pass levels are now gone. Tsk tsk tsk

been playing this for years and now changing my rating to 1 from 5 stars, negative even. the recent updates robbed us from the enjoyment we once had before. no more hours of unlimited power ups. the 'One try' level is designed to break your streaks, if u don't buy power ups, you will lose them altogether. This game is all about buying everything now. if u have coins, it will be almost impossible for you to beat the hard levels. they want you to spend your earned coins so that you can buy more.

I'm about to leave this games. everything getting expensive. every month spend more than $500 bucks. used to be around $30 & $50 for the package bundle. but now is around $50 & $60. not even last more than 4 days. then bought again in between $8 & $15 juz. too much for me to spend. and now I juz notice they changing ( reduced to be more exact )the booster to worst. good bye. time for me to save my money. Thanks for those WERE the good days. Been playing since Oct 2017.

IMPOSSIBLE to pass several games in a row since every other game you generate is HARD or SUPER HARD level!!! Was my favorite and the 1st mobile game since 2010's. More than a decade has passed, I've examined strategies, gained experience but now, especially with the latest update I feel like this game stopped being a relaxing one and turned into money making machine- It's impossible to enjoy, if you prefer to play for free. If I wanted to play something complicated I'd choose Assassin's Creed

Very much disappointed by the service. The game closed due to a software mistake. I lost the game, the magic hat and the super rainbow blast. I informed Gardenscape 3 days ago about this problem. But there is reaction, no proposal for solution, nothing. I was a frequent player but now I'm frustrated by the service and stopped playing. They have to significantly improve their service.

Decently interesting game but not really how it's advertised. Been playing for years and it's been mostly okay but it's almost impossible to get far without paying for bonuses and power ups. And then when things glitch and you lose your power ups it takes them ages to get it sorted and they sometimes just blame you and give you a couple of average power ups to somehow make it up or not give you any assistance or compensation for money or time wasted. Don't waste your money on this game.

This is an amazing game that has sadly been ruined by the nonstop nerfing of rewards and power ups. I assume this is to drive up purchases. In the past I happily bought things, but my whole team is about to quit now that they've made it impossible to progress without paying. it's a shame, as this game has been something I've enjoyed for a long time.

They seem to take away ways to earn boosters with each new update. The levels also become significantly more difficult to pass during special events, making it essentially impossible to progress far or complete the special events without paying. In effect, they put the prizes for these events behind a pay wall. The game wasn't like this when I started playing. You can easily spend days on a very hard level trying to pass it, and then as soon as the event is over you pass it easily.

I have played this game for more 10 yrs. but the latest update is extremely disappointing. The value of items has been drastically reduced, and advancing through stages now feels heavily pay-to-win. Players are forced to spend an unreasonable amount of money just to make progress. This update has made the game far less enjoyable.

Lovely game, but these constant upgrades are annoying! Why have we reduced the number of rewards we get! For example the Blueberry challenge awards! May we please go back to the way it was with awards if not better, if you'd love to upgrade, suree! Add more features and improve the graphics(they are amazing btw) but not lessen the awards we get! The game is already expensive as it is!

I loved this game. I've been playing it for years and I'm increasingly disappointed. The Golden Ticket used to cost £4.99 a month, now it's almost £9. Completing a level gave you 50 coins; now it's 10. All the boosters have been reduced. Even their timers work differently. Half an hour of unlimited lives combined with a half-hour booster like Rainbow Blast, and guess what? A half-hour Rainbow Blast ends 10 minutes faster than a half-hour of unlimited lives. Interesting, huh? Feed up with this.

The developers are ruining this game with every update. They cut the coins you get per normal level from 50 to 10, but kept the cost of 5 extra moves at 900 coins - making it much harder to afford. They removed any preview of what the level is going to be so you have no idea what boosters to use before you're in. However, as you go higher level, the frequency of purchasing will be more frequent. Hence, I have stop playing this game.

Solid gameplay, good graphics. The game overall is quite nice. But. They use ads what are falsely showing gameplay to be something else. Also some levels require using powerups (what lasts only the one go at the level), what you not might have (you can always buy more with your hard earned dollars), making this unforgettably annoyingly pay-to-win game. I want to pay because game feels so good, not because i have to, since it's supposed to be free-to-play. I used to like it, now i hate it.

If you want a game to pass free time then this is an awesome game. BUT, if you want to be serious in leveling up, expect to be frustrated. Lol. This game will be hard as you go on leveling up. And some levels are even designed to make you lose. So yeah. If you are prepared to be stressed, then this game is for you. And I'm level 2k plus and until now I'm still waiting for the minigames like in the ad. Maybe it will be on lvl 10k lmao

This game is terrible. The ad is lying to you people. Also there is another game called my home, and this game is exactly like that one. PLAGURISM!!! I thought you were only supposed to choose options when the garden was in trouble, but no. The ad only showed the part when he had nightmares. Plus when your finished playing the game part, you only get 1 star. I know that even other games would give you even more credit than this one. UNINSTALLED IT RIGHT AFTER DOWNLOADING IT - written by a child

I got to 6255. Levels now are like this: 50-60 attempts to pass to the next level and you get 2 normal levels then 1hard(red) + 1very hard (purple). It has become impossible and very frustrating to get to ne next level. I deleted the game and will never install it again. Even if you have all the levels completed you cannot build all the garden decorations available. You definetely need to spend money to complete levels, meaning it's a pay to win game.

The game is totally different from what they showed in the ad. It was a disappointment to me because the game I imagined from seeing the ad was not the game i played. But still I wished to continue to play. But my next disappointment was i couldn't able to buy extra moves when I couldn't complete the game in the given moves. The coins I earned is just approx. 70 per level. But extra moves is charged 900 which makes impossible to go to next level. But apart from these problems it is a good game.

This game used to be awesome, but with time it's becoming more of a money-grabber. The latest event made it sink even lower: you can't get a new advertised pet, unless you pay real money. A pity, the game is interesting to follow, but i do not support forcing players to buy stuff in a free game. And there's no progress here: another decoration that's only for real money is added. So, one star it is until this is resolved

Rarely leave any reviews, but this frustrated me so much that I think I should warn interested players that this game just wants you to pay so you get a chance to complete their higher levels. Imagine a new level with just one possible move, and after that move, the game tells you there's no other possible move thus resetting the puzzle, wasting your one move. DevS, you can make the game challenging. But not until it looks like the game itself Is cheating... Reminds me of EA games NFS payback.

Its definitely wrong to divert us from the real concept of the game through an ad! The ad was very misleading and not at all similar to the actual game. If you're new and would want to install, I assure you that the game is nowhere near the advertisement. The game is ok, but not what I wanted to play. Terrible, terrible advertisement. FIX IT.

This is just a match 3 game, and not the gameplay you see on the ads. The ads are faked to get you into the game. You have to wait 30 mins for each life, with a max of 5 accumulating. If you have the patience to spend day after day on the same hard level then this game is for you, otherwise you find yourself spending money in frustration to finish that level. Disappointing, as the game play on the ads looks much better than the actual thing.

Impossible levels for little reward. The idea is great and early levels interesting and challenging, they soon become frustrating. Fancy trying to get enough matches to get 64 flowers and 10 gnomes in 12 moves (hard level 54). Ridiculous unless you've somehow managed to save up an Armada or spent a lot of $. If you only have a short amount of spare time rather than gaming all day, don't waste your precious time on this.

Game becomes increasingly harder to the point you cannot pass a level without having to purchase coins. Game cleverly will not let you pass a level unless you use coins. Eventually you'll use up the coins you've collected and the only way to move on is to purchase more. Also I noticed that it seems when you free bombs etc for a given period of time the game runs very slow limiting the number of attempts to pass levels. Game is very well written to empty your bank account. FYI POINT.

While the structure and concept of the game is great, it lacks security issues. The game does not allow you to sign-in through a proper fb account. Instead it auto sign you in based on the account already in your mobile. The game makes you make the purchases because you will need the boosters to clear various stages, else your Garden will not get done. Worse of all, the app does not have security or choices in payment for making purchases. Being stuck at the same level for days is simply beyond

I'm uninstalling this app - I've played it for years on my Kindle and even spent real money on it, which I never do. But the deceptive advertising that doesn't match the gameplay and the heaps of special premium contests are too much. The ads show gameplay modes the game doesn't have and they're completely different from what the game actually is. And the game isn't as good as it used to be. The harder you try to make money and be cutting-edge, the less fun it is. Bye!

My last review of 3 stars was 5 years ago so time for an update. There are still no ads. There are practically no mini games except some time based "events" that while giving some rewards ask you to spend more money. The only way to meaningfully play the game is during the dog-gives-prizes streak get all the rewards and enjoy the starting bonuses. Otherwise it is just grinding the same level hoping for a lucky break. Otherwise it is just match three asking you to spend money.

Not as advertised. At all. The actual premise is fun enough. You play levels and get stars to do tasks in a garden. My main problem is that the games you play to earn stars are just another colour swap candy crush-esque affair. All the interesting looking problem solving games in the advert are false. They don't appear at all. When the ad says "not all representative of actual gameplay" what it means is "completely different game that you'll never find on this app".

As a game, 2 stars. As a business model, 5 stars. The game starts off easy enough, getting you slowly hooked & making you believe you have a chance. Then, as the levels progress, they get disproportionately more difficult, to the point the game is practically unbeatable unless you spend £££s for in game coins to buy power ups etc. Storyline is boring too, basically just candy crush crossed with a rubbish kids book

FALSE ADVERTISING AT IT'S BEST! Absolutely nothing like the ads I see for this game! The only true part of the ads I see for this game is the name......that's it! It's just a candy crush type game with a bit of story line, but 90% of the game is candy crush type stuff. If you are checking out the game because of the ads......you will be disappointed. Not even in the same ballpark.

Edit July 13th: the last update has just ruined the game. I cannot play anymore because it's keeping asking me to give access to my Fb friends list and the not now button doesn't work. It's a pitty! Love the game (i've just passed across the river) but what happened to "tap to skip"? It was a great idea and worked for one update only. Now it doesn't work anymore.

Truly a fun game for the first 50 or so levels. The puzzles are the most fun by far and the game's store page says there are a bunch of different minigames. The reality is that most of the time you are playing a candycrush knockoff that does not give you enough moves to do anything post level 60, and encourages you to spend money to have a slim chance to finish the level with 5 extra moves. Fun for a little bit but not worth the money it tries to get you to spend.

Fun at first. But the gnome "bejewelled" game is stupid. It constantly interrupts the game saying there are no moves left, yet there are, and forces you to spend money to keep playing. Frustrating. I just downloaded it for Austins Nightmares, which turns out is just a small part of the game. Overall a well created game, but talk about frustration..

Nothing like the adverts, it's basically like candy crush saga. It entices you in with a few easy levels, then gradually gets harder till you're going to have to start paying for addons to complete levels. If the game was a couple of pounds and there was no further ads or in game purchases I'd pay. This is rubbish though. I'll save my pennies for a decent PS4 game.

Very disappointed. The ads made it like a fun puzzle game and I installed it specifically to play those. Instead I spend 2+ hours on some Bejeweled clone with no hint of puzzles. I don't know if the puzzles show up a few days into the game or what but sitting through 2 hours of non-advertised mini-games to hope I find the actual reason I downloaded the game is a joke. If you're getting this because of the puzzle ads, just don't. Find another game that actually has them.

FALSE ADVERTISING!!! Advert is for a game where you escape from tricky situations using available options as provided by the game... looks kind of cool and sounded fun. What you get is COMPLETELY DIFFERENT!!! A game where you tend a garden!! Not the same thing, not even similar. Disgraceful advertising by this developer to increase the number of downloads. In future I will review all potential games thoroughly to ensure I never download another of this developers games.

The game isn't as advertised. Not a survivor choice game. It's a Candy crush nightmare without any of the fun of candy Crush (which isn't much to begin with) the game requires Stars in order to complete actions. Stars are earned by beating Candy Crush levels. But levels can be so hard so that boosts are required. In-game money is so hard to acquire that you cannot afford to buy boosts. I got to level 76 and it is tedious too hard without spending real money which I won't do.

This is not a review of gardenscapes alone, it's a review on playrix's ad choices. I see completely misleading ads, which have nothing at all to do with the actual gameplay. I've actually downloaded and played a few of their games but this is just getting ridiculous. Just because it may come cheap, it doesn't mean we get played for fools. Another 'challenge/fail' ad and I'm out

used to love this game but like many others. The bonus bombs from the challenge levels aren't given anymore, the number of moves in each game has reduced making it much harder, more harder levels have been added and the bonus games are becoming harder to complete due to the energy spent being higher. I think trying to get people to spend money or more money when money is already tight so I'll now be removing this game and finding another. which is a shame after getting to 7403.

If you are installing this game coz of their ad, then DON'T. This game is nothing like you saw in the ad. It's just another candy crush lookalike. You get coins for completing each round and can use that coin to buy things to decorate a garden. When I saw the ad, I thought it must be a fun game to play. I played for hours thinking, maybe the actual game will be available after completing few rounds. Wasted my time. I don't understand why Google won't take any action against such misleading ads.

This game is not as advertised in the videos. Please look into it, you advertise it as a puzzle solving game. Where in the game characters are in a given situation and you have to choose an option for them to move forward, but after the download it's just a match 3 game (like candy crush) this is false advertising. Basically you people are cheating because if they advertise the real thing they won't get so many downloads. Very very disappointed. I would give 0 stars but that isn't an option.

This game has held my interest forever. I didn't buy helpful items for ages. Now, I'm wondering why you charge so much -- it cuts out much of the fun. It can take a long time to solve some levels. All puzzles can be solved, eventually, but it's hard without boosters. Austin & his dog & cat are funny. I like how the rabbit, frog, birds, squirrel & hedgehog jump if I touch them. Very good graphics! Thanks! Still TOO expensive!!! Update: App won't open today. Help! Then, make it cheaper, PLEASE!!!

I would give "Gardenscapes" a lower rating due to its heavy reliance on in-app purchases, which can hinder progress and limit gameplay. Additionally, some players may find the abundance of ads or feel that the game lacks fresh content. These aspects could impact the overall gaming experience. However, ratings may vary based on individual preferences.

For prospective players of this game, you need to understand one thing, there's very little skill involved. There's an algorithm that 'decides' when it's time for you to lose or be forced to spend upwards of 2,100 coins to continue, even if you've got the super rainbow blast and have used additional boosters. This happens on so called easy rounds too. Essentially it decides when you lose. Pretty dishonest way of designing a game, but I guess its designed to get you hooked, then spend £\$

First thing first, false advertising. I saw this ad in another game multiple times, sad stories about mothers and childs figuring out a solution to not freeze, u have to place planks, repair things, warming up rooms and so on. This game is not about that. In fact, its a candy crush mechanism match different fruits, combos, and every now and then you will get a little short quest remotely close to the advertisement. Other than that, 90% candy crush wanna be.

Content wise it is a very good game and keeps you engaged. However, once you reach the top levels, the game transforms into pure greed, spelt with a capital G. It becomes almost impossible to move forward without purchasing coins or power ups. And even that doesn't guarantee that your move to the next level. On many occasions, the game algorithm will not let you move forward at all and will try to exhaust your purchases immediately. I am not going to purchase anything in this game again.

Just another Candy Crush clone and not a very good one at that. Match 3 candies... Oh no wait, it's fruit, cause you're in a garden. Get it? YAWN! And you're digging out gnomes. DOUBLE YAWN! As pointed out by others, major false advertising showing fun puzzle games (do they ever actually happen in the game? I'm not going to play hundreds of levels of match 3 just to find out!) but the real game is something else. Very misleading, I know it's free but it's still unethical. Uninstalled.

Undisguised money grabbing. The levels are too hard to be enjoyable, way too few moves and buying more moves is often not feasible, because earning the gold is very slow and if you don't want to spend real money on the gold you've already earned through gameplay, you're out of luck. Aside from the fact that the game is not, what is advertised. Uninstalled.

CHANGING MY RATING INTO NEGATIVE IF THAT'S EVEN POSSIBLE. Update sucks!! It now takes time to load the game which has never happened before. PLUS, I've been playing this game for years now, and you made it not fun anymore. All we have to do is purchase anything what you offer so it'll be easier for us to surpass every level. While if you just play not relying on any booster, it'll took months for us to pass just one! Thinking of uninstalling it right now. So disappointed.

this game is frustrating! some levels are impossible to pass coz of the move numbers you give does not much the hardness of the level and please don't get me started on the time it takes to get 1 life half an hour, really ? it takes two hours and a half to get all 5 of them do you really want people to play ? i get it this way people start to buy gold and you earn some money but they can delete and install some other games too😒😒😒

Played for years, the recent "makeover" challenges get you to take a poor disadvantaged or angry woman and make her over to improve her life. After 7242 levels completed I'm uninstalling. Hideous message. Make it about gardening, like the name of the game. Plenty of misogynistic games out there for people to choose if that's what they want, this shouldn't be one of them.

Get your credit card ready. Once you get to a certain level the only way you're going to pass most levels is by paying for more powers and even those won't last long.If you have the patience to play on the same level for days,then eventually they will drop a couple of bombs to move you to the next level,,,then it's same thing unless you want to keep paying for just enough powers to get you through a few levels,,and then it's time to buy more. Trust me...find another game,save your money.

This game is a cash cow. You will spend hours trying to beat levels hoping the "random" selection will let you win this time. Or you will have to spend dollar after dollar of real money. The levels are intentionally designed to force you to spend money on extras. The game could be fun, the premise is great. But who wants to sit around waiting for lives to fill up so you can try to beat the same level over and over again? I'm embarrassed by how much of my money I let this game have.

Pretty good in the early game, but then you hit a paywall. It gets to the point where the level is too hard for you to beat but you don't have any power-ups and you've ran out of in-game money. The game makes you spend money so you can buy more lives or power-ups. You don't have any other options than to spend money or stop playing. This game is also the prime example of deceptive advertisement, with these Mini-games barely being in the game, even though they're the only things to appear in ads.

Advert depicts a puzzle game where you save a character from a threat by moving things. This is false advertising. The game is just bejewelled. Do not download. They should either advertise the game it is or make the game they are advertising. It's pathetic honestly. If they said it was bejewelled, I might have tried it. I even play candy crush (who don't lie in their adverts).

Starts off as a get 3 identical objects in a row type of game, much like candy crush. I don't like this kind of simple game. I had been hoping to play the game where the logic of which pin gets pulled and in which order (as it shows in the ads) advances play. I deleted the game after a disappointing 5 min. No fun for me, just a waste of my time.

excellent time waster - can avoid spending money, but you might feel like dropping a couple of quid here and there EDIT - a few years after my initial review and, while the Devs have continued to update the game, some of these updates have become very anti-consumer, breaking streaks, virtually forcing you to buy coins etc. I've now quit (at max level).

This game is misadvertised as a logic puzzle game. In reality you get one logic puzzle per game day. The rest of the time you must play a version of candy crush to gain lives to advance each game day. The only way to pass the "super difficult level" (their description not mine) is to buy credits. Even then there is no guarantee of advancement. Also facebook is a requirement for extra lives. Frustrating and disappointing. I had reached level 70 but had only advanced 4 game days.

Here's the thing. I gave this game 30 minutes or so and that's it. First of all, the ads lie about the game play. It's not some brain teaser game on how to get to the treasure. Maybe down the line, but not where I played. It's a general candy crush swap and get three type of game. It's the same basic mechanics with a few twists. Probably fun building your garden, but I can't see it. You notice early that this game also relies heavily on microX

it was fun a first. just recently I noticed that the game has been making the "normal" levels impossible to pass without using the coins. it's a patterm actually. The normal levels before the "hard" or "super hard" levels will force you to use the coins so that you don't have enough coins to get a few extra moves when you can't pass the hard levels which are right after. Do not think using the bombs or rainbows will help you. YOU WILL HAVE TO PAY.

What has happened to this game.. I've seen so many strange ads for it recently that seem to point towards a completely different game mechanic??? My original review of 5 stars doesnt even reflect how I feel about it anymore. I'm sure the original devs weren't too happy with the direction this has gone in either. 😒 Not impressed with their business practices and decisions. Keep it to quality art and fun match 3, don't jump on silly moneymaking bandwagons!

I used to enjoy playing, but it's now not worth it any longer. Its VERY FRUSTRATING and when you are stuck on a level that gives limited moves and so much to achieve well not any longer it's not worth the time or giving them your WiFi. I have already uninstalled a good number of times and reinstalled but alas you get so much infinity with boosters but then get stuck on another level which can take up to 2 weeks to get through it. A game like this should be enjoyed not FRUSTRATING. IM DONE!!!!!!

Nothing like the ads that sucker you in to installing this game, but thought I'd give it a go anyway. It's just another version of candy crush that then allows you to complete tasks to build your garden. Like most games, easy and enjoyable for the first few days, then you hit levels that are can't be beaten unless you part with real money to buy the boosters. I don't see why developers can't just charge a small nominal amount to buy the game in the first place but make everything achievable.

Far too heavily reliant on purchasing of coins etc to complete levels. You can do a level 100 times and still not get through it. Even after purchasing and using bombs and extra moves is no guarantee and is most likely that it will not help you. Has the making of a good game but not if you cannot complete levels within reasonable attempts or use of extras. There are better games out there. Don't bother with this. Just not worth it. That's it cya, better games out there!!!

Ok so in all honesty i think that this is a good game. obviously a fair amount of effort has gone towards the game both inside and outside of the levels. but really the thing that truly brings the game down is the advertising. it's nothing like the game, and i see no reason why it exists. In itself the game is good, so advertise what you have IN the game not a obviously faked minigame that isn't in the game. I'm not mad, just disappointed.

So where do I begin? Its quite pointless, being called Gardenscapes when most of the your time is spent playing basically fruit candy crush, which if your actually interested in gardening is very disappointing. You have no option not to play for stars to be able to do anything in your garden!! Also you have no option not to save in a safe wich you then have pay real mo ey for, which is absurd. I gave it 2 stars only because I suppose if you like this kind of game at least the graphics are good!

At one point of the game the puzzles come down to luck, and not necessarily skill. It beats the purpose of solving puzzles when sometimes you simply can't solve a puzzle, however, you will get punishment for failing. Finally, this game requires a lot of time and effort, but you'll receive little in return. Careful, because this is a money trap.

Sneaky and deceptive, cash power ups appear in place of the replay button periodically so when you're expecting to hit replay you end up buying something you didn't want. No "are you sure?" message pops up. If you've spent real money adding coins on the game then they're effectively stealing your money by cleverly making purchases pop up where you don't expect them. Illegal surely

Awfully depressing game. Been playing for a long time now. When I first played it was enjoyable, the levels were easy with plenty of moves left over. Lots of bonuses and power ups and coins given for completing a level. But now, ALL the levels are hard and some are near impossible and take days if not weeks to complete. I can't gain power ups because I lose every level at least five times before finally passing. And getting enough coins for extra moves also takes weeks to collect. Uninstalling.

First of all, it is false advertising. It is not like what u saw in the ad, it is 'Candy Crush' matching colours kinda game. But I play it anyway, to waste time. For people who said its money grabbing game. Why would u spend money on the game? You can win without paying any money. The algorithms of the game made it hard for u to solve... but that's the point. They will make it hard & entice u to pay for lives & etc. If u keep rejecting the promos, the game will eventually become easy to win.

Entertaining game! Fun to be designing your own garden. Downside? Literally not enough moves on some of the levels. Forces you to buy coins to pass the level, only to be used on stuff that is really silly. Such as helping a guy with his first date or another guy looking for a coffee palace. I don't know about everyone else. But I don't have a vast amount of money to put into my virtual garden. Might be unistalling the app soon. As fun as it is to play.

I got to level 6321. Do not install this game. The phrase "chasing cars" comes to mind. It keeps you on the same level for days if not weeks. Even when you try to pay to get through it won't always let you. Its frustrating, aggravating and an absolute scam designed to coerce money out of you. Oh, and the storage capacity you need to continue to progress through the levels and update the app is insane. Anyways, I deleted this game this morning.

This game became frustrating to a point it's no longer enjoyable. Coins reward for completing the level dropped by about 70%, it's extremely hard to complete levels, sometimes I am stuck for days. I know they want you to pay money. They say they have amazing side tasks and bonuses, well I never completed one because I am stuck in the game. If something doesn't change, you will keep receiving low ratings.

Frustrating on harder levels when you know things should work out different. Super hard levels are designed to keep you there. Not great.... Why do it. I don't want to spend real money to pass a level. Some of these levels keep you stuck for days..... Really puts you off.. Game is a joke... Don't download you will get extremely frustrated. Why do you create levels that canno be passed without in app purchases. For 7 days I have been stuck on a level because there aren't enough moves to complete.

Usually I would say this game is great but I'm not sure I want to play after 2103 levels as their contact support is not very good. I didn't receive my in app purchase and trying to get the purchase or a refund is the hardest thing ever. I have contacted them three times and the first time I was promised someone would get in contact and they didn't, second and third time the messages appeared in another language.

I have been playing this game for years. The game creators' greed has gone way overboard now; I find myself irritated with every level I play. I know games want to make money, but this game has turned into an overt money grab. With much lower rewards for playing levels, it takes forever to save up 900 coins just for 5 more moves. The prices for in-game purchases have gone up by a lot and you get much less for your money. You can't tell me these changes are meant to make the game more enjoyable!

I think you could be more generous with coins and stars, there are 3 levels of difficulty, there should be 3 levels of prizes, and the prizes on the wheel could be getter too. I do love all the different hazards, ( boxes, bags, etc.) and the areas are so fun to decorate. Edit: Jun18, 2020 I lowered it to 2 stars because Gardenscapes has chosen not to listen to it's players very valid complaints. I play, but don't attempt any specials. Your company doesn't seem to care about it's players .

Why are you showing lies for this game in the app and in the ads you put out there. There is no saving people or any of the other thing. Its too bad its just another match game. Its all false advertising as far as i'm concerned. Do you show the lies hoping to get people interested and when we download its nothing like what you are showing. Very disappointed. Too bad tho would have been a better game with the false adv. stuff. Oh well one less game to play.

Sorry, but negative review from me. Im level 7000+ and been playing and purchasing for years. The game has become impossible, unless you use boosters, then these stupid pink levels kill you, no matter how many you use, therefore killing your progress and momentum. All boosters you've accumulated GONE... The more you purchase, the more it wants from you! Definitely changed for the worse recently!!!

I loved this game! I have been playing for over 6 years. But these challenge levels are ridiculous to beat so you can't even keep your boosters earned from the previous levels. The prices on coins have gone up and I used to buy them periodically, but now, 3.15 to buy 1000 coins is insane. Sometimes it takes me 3 days to beat a level and that is insane. Also, why can't I use my google play money to buy coins or lives?

Just another generic match 3 game. Downloaded as sadly the adverts have worked on my and thought it would be have more puzzles but they are few and far between and it's not long before the game is asking you to spend money. Wish they have a version where you could just pay a flat fee but they are fishing for the whales which I understand. Not for me but if you enjoying candy crush etc and want to play a game that begs for money like that this is a good choice

Was enjoying this game till I got to level 115. Now you get 13 moves to try & beat the level which is absolutely impossible & because I cannot get buy it (even after spending money for the bombs etc), there is NOTHING else I can do in this game at all. The higher levels are nothing but a money grab & the game becomes unplayable unless you put in a lot of money. 😡

I absolutely loved this game 3 years ago and only just uninstalled it, because it's becoming so much harder to get through a level. That's fine and all because that's the fun challenging part. However, I have been on one level for over a week, it's virtually impossible. Then it keeps flashing purchase this, or that. Then you double the price for the golden ticket. That's insanity seriously. Why? Virtually doubled. A wonderful game that has been ruined due to greed. Lots of $$ lost . DONE!!!

This game is fun to play but in the end a total rip off.I have spent more than I care to admit and it goes so quickly. As other players before me have reported, many levels are very difficult to get through. I think they hide hard levels under easy ones because some seem too hard to get through for so-called easy ones. Also, why 900 coins to get 5 more moves and then 1200 if you need more tries?! 5 moves should be no more than 500 coins. Reduce your prices for coins and boosters!

If you have come here after having watched an ad showing cute puzzles then you are wrong. The main part of the game is about gem matching puzzles that are not shown in the ad. You have to play them and their difficulty is increasing till it becomes so dependant on luck. I don't mean it's bad and has no excitement at all.... But beware. It is like other games of this type, You could spend hours playing those gem matching puzzles to get to the cute puzzles that you have watched in the ads.
Chat now restricted in UK!! No age verification option.

All of a sudden, the game is malfunctioning. Started happening a few days ago, hasn't helped to restart my phone or tablet. I keep getting a pop-up window saying "oops, looks like something went wrong." But when I tap ok, same thing pops up again repeatedly. I think it was after an update installed, but not 100% certain. I enjoy the game, but this isn't the first time it's been rendered unusable after an update, so I'm pretty unimpressed.

Misadvertised. I kept seeing ads for this game where you need to rescue someone with some logical puzzles, but when I downloaded it it was more about tidying a garden and bursting bubbles in a candy crush like manner. It was still fun for a while with great graphics which is why I gave it 3 stars. But it's not the game I wanted and I couldn't figure out how to play the advertised game instead.

Boring. The ad show logic, problem solving game but the game is 3 in a row matching and there a far better 3 in a row games available. If you have difficulty clearing a level you either have to wait for an additional life or buy some, as it isn't the game that was advertised there is no way I would pay money to continue playing. Deleting it as soon as I've finished writing this.

False advertising. If you have seen an advert for this game where you choose items to either save or fail to save people in danger, please be aware that there is none of that in the game.
