High production values. Good graphics, with solid game play. Story fell short; I don't feel like the owner, I feel like the butler's gopher, every tiny task costs stars. Like looking up a number, calling that number, having the person called actually do something. Then, oops I ruined your work. Please pay to fix my screw up. It's fairly annoying. Also, I'm not going to say the game is a cash grab, perhaps I could play better, but it FEELS like one. Many of the levels are balanced harshly and strongly encourage paying to win with tools or extra moves. There is too much RNG and your move limit gets very restrictive as you progress. And everything is just priced too high for how frequently they come up. Enjoyed for a while, but will probably uninstall shortly.

Addictive, difficulty curve is excellent, beautiful graphics, fun story and easy ui. Levels are challenging but doable. A little planning and a little luck make this a satisfying experience. No money needed, just patience and brain power. To those who find the difficulty too high; don't give up hope, you'd be surprised how many times things fall into place in the final few moves. Level 3000 and counting. Loving the new sections.

I like the game, I like the challenge but after awhile my determination left me. The game is too hard, the rewards you get after time and times of trying is not very encouraging. Cost too much to get the extension to finish the game, in the end I just get sick of it and don't want to play anymore. I think I'll uninstall it...there's no more fun in the game..really sad. I like the game and still playing .. may be the developer could rewards each game you won by replacing the boosters you used.

just when I thought, this game was better, something annoying came up just like It always happened with the other. I have reached level 29, it was hard, the hardest without boosters, I mean what do you expect? people buying coins so we can play unlimited? If buying is not possible, I dont mind watching ads as long as its not too many . come on, games are supposed to be fun.

Why are all these games being advertised incorrectly. They all suggest an option based game where you select on of the options yo progress however when you install the games they are puzzle games in which you have to earn stars to advance. Surely this us against trade descriptions act as it is falsely advertising the product as something it isnt just to trick people into installing the app. I like the puzzle games such as this one and homescapes but the advertisement is a massive let down.

I have been playing this game on and off for quite a few years and it was a good game to play. It use to be a nice distraction while travelling to work on public transport and on my break at work etc. However what I have found is that the game has become so difficult in beating the levels it is not enjoyable to play anymore and I have removed the app from my phone.

Play to win con. Spent $86.81 in 1.5 weeks, now deleted the app after I'd built up 15000 coins over a couple of days only to reduce them to 200 in the space of a day, having to use them to get extra moves for solving puzzles. Can't move forward unless you pay, or make attempts for days on a hard puzzle. The amount of times you are 1 move away before running out of moves means it's obviously programmed to remove cash out your wallet. Otherwise a well done game, using psychology against you.

Unfortunately the game is cheating and the levels are too hard. I pressed for 5 extra moves that cost 900 coins and the coins were taken but I didn't get the moves. In addition I bought coins and bundle of bombs but got only half of the coins surprisingly. I contacted the customer support they told me to send a screen shot of the purchase, which I did but didn't hear anything back for 2 days. It said I have to do the update of the app which I can't at the moment. No good

Used to be fun, now it's frustrating. Pink "Challenge" levels are designed to make players lose their booster streak. Moves reduced on most levels to slow the game down unless money is spent on boosters and lives. Really disappointing, I've played since the start, but am questioning why I am still doing so. Gameplay has been modified to gain money, and the sad thing is, the addicted players will always spend it.

First 10 minutes of the game are great, then it turns into every other game designed to drain your wallet, a sudden difficulty spike so you have to keep spending real money to progress. The quicker these vermin companies are banned the better, i'd have rather paid £10 for the game without constantly being asked to spend money just to progress.

This game is not as advertised and I feel robbed. I've played through a few levels hoping that as the garden is set up, I'll actually get to play what was advetrisd but that doesn't seem like the reality. I will be deleting the game as I did with homescapes. They need to actually give the game they advertised. I was looking forward to a puzzle game not something Sims like kmt

..MORE FALSE ADVERTISING.. I played this game for a few months and it was nothing like the exciting gameplay shown in the adverts! These developers are lying to us. If your expecting the gameplay from the advert go elsewhere, if you want a candy crush style game then this is your jam. Extremely dis-appointed and a bit pissed off. Getting real sick and tired of being lied to. Losing faith fast.

I've been playing this game for 7+ years. Last updates brought too many bugs when I lost life's and points, and support doesn't help me at all. Also, easy levels become as hard as red and purple ones, so I can play an easy levels for days and waiting for luck only, nothing depends on me. You can clearly see how the game pushes you to spend cash. Before that I willingly spent money to embrace game developers, now I just want to delete the game. Unfortunately.

Only 1 star due to false advertising. The game itself is great and can become addictive. However it really annoys me when I see their playable adverts, it's totally nothing like the game! You need to be truthful about the games content to get people on board & to stay loyal, lying to customers is not going to keep them playing the game, they will just uninstsll. Please stop the fake ads!!

Don't bother with this game!!Utter greed of the company behind this game takes all the fun out of it. The levels get to the point that there is no way you can even get close to passing a level without paying for more coins and explosives etc- these don't help very often, the game feels rigged to make you spend more money. The additional game is equally frustrating as you cannot move forward very far because you need to use a lot of energy/points to move objects out of your way. Very expensive!!!

Gardenscapes was a very fun game until the blowing up tanks showed up. I stopped playing other games because they did the same thing, it seems the only way to beat the blowing up tanks is to pay money which to me feels like extortion, another excellent game ruined by something totally beyond control. Which reminds me who has propane or gas tanks in their garden anyways!!!

Misleading ads. Nothing like how they promote this game. What you see in the ads is a very tiny (about 2%) side to the main game every now and again. The actual game itself would probably be ok if its what you're looking for... But it's not as fun, exciting or playable as the ads make it look. Google need to clamp down on this false advertising. I'm guessing this is what's eld to a host of underwhelming reviews.

The Ads conveyed that it was a sort of puzzle game, but utterly disappointed when I started playing. Its a match 3 game, atleast the initial levels are. I don't have the patience to complete these stupid match 3 levels to reach the puzzle levels, if they are indeed there. Please don't give misleading ads to lure people to download your game.

I think my previous review was removed, but I'm here again to say that the base game itself and the events are not bad, it's a solid match 3 game. The ads, however, are completely atrocious, as someone who actually pays attention to the story and characters, the ads are a complete lie and a scam, the woman are the girl are not even related, and there is no such thing as "unlocking all levels" the minigames are present but optional and are fairly easy, and the background music is needlessly sad.

I enjoy the game but I've some how gotten booted from it. I made a purchase but something happened either on my end or theirs or both, not the point. The point is I went to their help section asked the customer service team about it and got ignored for 9 hours. When I pointed it out that it had in fact been over 9 hours I was kicked out and now can't use the game. So don't complain or nicely ask questions they won't help or they will kick you out.

Over 5 years of playing this game and I still love it. Level 4085. The game has changed a lot over the years and this is what I've found: The new mini games are really engaging, and the competitive nature spurs you on up the levels. The garden tasks are less tedious as you progress through the game. No one wants to rebuild something they've already made. The story has really sweet moments and I've had to screen grab them. I do miss the seasons items as redecorating my garden was half the fun.

Now we are at the higher levels it's starting to become ridiculous to pass a level. This was once a game I would play over and over even while waiting for new levels. Now it is so frustrating and you watch the colours fall and you can see they would fall into a bomb or a dynamite and before they settle and give you the booster they combo up differently and give you nothing. I've been playing for so long and have always loved this game and rated it highly but now I'm not so sure anymore.

This has some of the most misleading ads In the damn galaxy. In the ads, the game actually looked alright. But when you boot up the game, it's just a match 3 game (the bottom of the barrel when it comes to game developing.) I mean the cutscenes look alright, but the game is utter trash. DO NOT INSTALL THIS GAME!

I used to like this game a lot, but as with the reviews from many others, to the levels have gotten ridiculously difficult, to the point it's no longer enjoyable. I do like a challenge, but this is supposed to be entertainment, not lead to frustration. I'm not sure if it's a way to get players to purchase add ons. With Homescapes at least you get the opportunity to have boosts every seven days to help you beat the level. But not with Gardenscapes. You end up stuck on the same level for days.

I was attracted to this game for the puzsels of helping the Mother and child or the Cat and Dog. But I rarely get to see that. The puzzles are harder and it makes you spend money to buy points just to pass. It's annoying. Why use the puzzles in the advert but rarely show them during the game??? Might be installing soon. Sad that I've gone so far but it's not interesting anymore.

Another game falsely advertised as a choose an option to avert impending doom when, in reality, it's a match 3 game. You have to question why the developers are so insecure about the game as to resort to blatantly false and misleading advertisement. The game itself is enjoyable enough although ridiculously difficult at points prompting you to give up or spend...giving up being the better, more cost effective option.

Its nothing like the ad. It too different from what is shown in the video. I would really like it if the advertisement depicted something right. The ad looked fun and the whole doesnt exist in the real game. you are losing customers by false advertising. I didnt download any of your other games due to this reason. I will suggest you show the real gameplay. You will get way many customers than you have now.

Absolutely love this game! However it is wayyyy to expensive when looking to buy coins or boosters. When you win a round you get like maximum 120 coins for 1 game. But to add on an extra 5 moves it costs 900 coins. Ridiculous pricing definitely. Tho I'm on like level 1300 so it hasn't put me off. Just puts me in bad form when you play this long and still cannot save any coins as they just so easily spent rather than saved. Would recommend tho,, good game to distress :)

The same as homescapes Nothing like the ads! Dont believe one minute it's ever gona be like the ads. I've played it for a few days to see it it goes from a candy crush type game to a decision game like the ads will have you believe but it doesn't, in fact it just gets frustrating and very repetitive. I mean if you like that sort of thing then by all means this is the game for you... but in my opinion it's just a click bait game.

I've been playing this for some time and I'm very glad that it allows you to play for free without insistent ads (or by making it really hard to progress without any paid-for bonuses). The storyline is somewhat engaging, and the puzzles can be hard, but not enough to discourage you from playing. HOWEVER, it is a match-three style game, and has nothing to do with what is advertised. You basically complete levels, and get stars to 'fix' things around the garden (instead of 'saving' anyone).

Make no mistake, this game is all about making money . . . off you! Barely a round goes by that you can complete first time and the number of times youre left needing one piece to complete is suspicious to say the least. That said, if you have patience, all levels are winnable, but you can be stuck on some for ages. Im currently on level 433. In conclusion I'd say, good game but with one big flaw. the developers are too greedy and at times that can take the enjoyment out of it, hence 3 stars

I've had this game and the homescape one for quite some time now and suddenly these advertisements pop up in all the other games i play. false advertisements. which is just low. the games are nothing like the advertisement, though i wish they were cuz then they might be a little more fun. if you get stuck in a level theres really not much you can do. it takes too many stars to do things.

The Pros: no ads, generally a good match 3 game. The cons: game has become a cash grab. You will get punished for getting rewards, for example, you win free lives means you will get stuck on one level for the duration of your lives. No skip button, there needs to be one. No point playing a game when you can't move on. Am on levels higher than 10000 so I dont need links on how to win. A pretty good game, but it will set you up to lose or not let you move on in the hopes you'll spend money.

the game is good but I don't like that the preview I saw hasn't actually occured yet in the game and I'm not sure it will. The game is addictive and I do like the challenges, i wish there were more options to make the garden more like what I want and not just what I am told to do. perhaps even more choice of the events or tasks to complete. e.g. choose your own next task from several options and based on that, the game play continues.

The designs of the gardens are beautiful and decorating is fun. I had downloaded the app thinking it was all about the gardens. What really happens is that I spend most of my time trying to beat levels of a tedious game to get the stars that I need to arrange the gardens. Most are so diffcult I need to spend hours trying to pass them, and the HONEY is horrendous, NOT FUN AT ALL! Not worth the hassle. If you don't improve I will uninstall the app.

Like others I thought this game was a puzzle game, getting characters out of silly situations, being creative with what tools you have. Instead you have to play a match game (similar to Candy Crush) to earn stars in order to do tasks around the place - I say you do tasks, more like you watch boring animations of the butler doing them. If Candy Crush with a story is for you, then enjoy, if you were hoping for something silly but puzzling then go elsewhere. Uninstalled.

Well it used to be a fun game, now it's a slog, I'm on level 7500 but now it's all but impossible to pass certain levels, then all of a sudden it gets ridiculously easy and you advance 4 or 5 levels then back to stalling. No sense of achievement, I just don't feel inclined to spend days and days on one level to have it "gifted" to you, it's free and no external ads which is a plus so 2 stars for that but the game itself is now no longer fun, I may try again in the future but for now unistalled

Fantastic game in every aspects. Or at least I would buy it to have fun and relax. However it is free to play but after a while you find some barrier you cant jump unless you pay for gold, which probably would be only the beginning of this ride. If you don't have problems investing a price of a higher tier board game to this, then you may be lucky enough that may be enough until the end. Or maybe you just pay again and again.It gets fustrating really fast without paying for it.

Advertising misleading, there is almost no escape games, just another candycrush. Waste of time to hope to get to the escape games, really annoying! All advertisements are about the escape parts and yet it is almost no existent in the game. I dont understand the intent behind it. It is just frustrating for those who want to play tha escape games and dont find it.

At first i gave 5stars, but i am lowering down to 2 because i am stuck in level 25 because some puzzles are too hard, ive been trying for 2 days, and cant pass the level. you only have 5 lives and for each puzzle you only get one star to do chores, ao you have to wait twenty minutes each time..it got very frustrating at this point i am about to quit. there is no help or clues at all to help us on the puzzles...so 2 stars, one because the game could offer so much more and two because it is cute.

If I could give this game a 0 or a ½ star I would. PERIODT‼ Don't let the 5 stars fool you, If you go on their facebook page and read some of the comments there you'll see that alot of people are having different problems with this game and it might seem like everything is okay at first when you're playing but they will pop up on you later on in the game. There were times where I couldn't past one so called "easy" level for two to three weeks even if I used money to buy the packages they offer.

First of all they are doing false advertising on social media. Showing as if you would be solving interesting puzzles but in reality it is just a glorified Candy Crush. Still I gave it a try to kill time, but now after reaching higher level, there is no getting ahead. You end up playing the same level multiple times hoping some luck would clear that level.

This has the potential to be an excellent game but the levels are so hard to complete without spending money, which I won't do. The tasks take way too many stars which are so difficult to get in the first place. Make the levels easier to achieve, give more rewards, provide some incentives to stay with the game! I'm sorry, but I am uninstalling, life is too short to spend DAYS trying to complete a level and not even earn enough to carry out one task.

Gardenscapes and myself have had something of a love hate relationship for some time; I've installed and uninstalled it maybe four times so far. It's a fun game and whimsical in a sense, but like most match 3 games, it's plagued by freemium rubbish. I can't even begin to describe how juxtaposed a pound sign popping up in such a cartoonish and childlike world is, not to mention disturbing. On the plus, you can get by as F2P, though it is far from easy (which is the point, of course).

I find it disappointing. I was playing this game a long time ago, and I installed it back when I saw the new ads campign. I thought you've added a new staff and adventure gameplay even though in a conjunction with the classic type but I figured out that it's just for the sake of fooling users to install it. thank you for the trick. good try.

This game is fun and addicting. Some levels might be extremely hard but that's about it. Typical match-3 games can always be frustrating and you have to be prepared to rage quit when you can't pass a level. Remember that, folks. My BIGGEST complain here, however, are the new ads. They don't match the game at all. False advertisement! Other Playrix games such as homescapes and fishdom have the same problem as well. It's a shame 'cause Playrix used to be one of my favorite game developers.

The ads are very misleading, like very much am not even sure that if it legal or not. You download it to play something but get something else. The renovating part is fun and all but the match making game, it's boring no doubt but also difficult. You gotta wait and play in patience again and again to just renovate something. If we had to play that then we could have played candy crush instead, why would we come here. It should have been fun escape and renovating game. Very disappointed.

I love decorating things so this is right up my alley, but I HATE it when it comes to collecting stars. It starts off easy but once you get going the levels get really hard. And because you can't complete the levels, you can't get any stars so you're just stuck until you beat the level (unlikely) or spend all your real money getting boosters to actually have a chance at beating the level. I could say a lot more things but here you go. Don't get this game unless you want to waste all your money.

recently decided to download it again and although it started off fun, I'm at point where I get impossible "hard" or "super hard" levels that can take DAYS to do more frequently than I get fun and normal levels which kills the game. I also really hate the fact that it costs so many stars to do things that are irrelevant rather than use them to have the fun to make your garden look nice. I've seen responses to similar comments and it's clear the creator cares more about money than it's customers.

I saw an add about doing puzzles to get characters out of trouble but got this aligning fruits instead. That was weird but I kept playing. Basically I get that apps entice you to spend money but with this game it's so blatantly obvious. I played for a month and spent $100 already just to enjoy the game and finish levels. Though the graphics are nice I didnt appreciate how it forces you to spend money. I uninstalled it today and will not install again.

Uninstalled it. Simply put: false advertising. It is a match 3 game, not a puzzle game to fix up a garden as shown in the ads. I don't like match 3 games, so I found this game boring and tiresome. Gardenscapes: if you don't falsely advertise, people like me won't try your game and leave a bad review. Instead, you'll get people who really do like the game to try it and leave a review.

I'm not the only person saying this in these reviews, there are soooo many people saying this exact same thing ;- The levels need to be made a little more easier to complete as you progress along to the higher levels. It's ridiculously hard to beat and will result in players just becoming bored of playing the app trying to pass near impossible levels therefore you will lose alot of players as they'll just uninstall after so long.

I love this game for the most part, but getting very upset with two aspects. The 1st is some levels take too long to pass them. I think if you use all your lives 3 or 4 times you should be able to pass on next level. I shouldn't have to spend real money to buy bombs and stuff. 2nd when you use bombs and stuff. They always drop them where they are useless. Waste of time and money.

Good game, but on some animations you cannot skip (while the butler talks on the phone, or shows you tricks, bla bla. Im in for the playtime, not to watch cartoons! Would highly appreciate if there could be a setting to skip animations. Might be my patience, but I really don't wanna spend 15-20 seconds every 8-10 levels. (There's a skip option, but in some cases doesn't come up and you have to watch the story)

When will you guys address the many reviews that point out the false advertising with this game? I, too, saw an ad for this game in another game and found it intriguing. This game has nothing to do with the ad. Does the "find your way out of situation" challenge ever happen in the game? This is super frustrating as you are blatantly lying to us.

Having played this game for over 2 years, I've officially seen my motivation to continue drop. The maps are repetitive and impossible to complete without spending money. The 50% discount hour was a fantastic idea that actually made me want to play again. This map didn't have that anymore and as a result I hardly played. The fun is gone this way. Bring back decoration challenges and fewer maps. And don't remove the 50%. Keep it doable.

The usual match 3 however, there are no vertical/ horizontal blasts (removing several tiles/ pieces) only larger explosions , making the game more difficult. Also the wild card will not copy power ups. The alure of the game however "freeze the spider" and the like do not exist and the developer is blatantly lying to its would be gamers. - Recommend avoiding.

It is NOT a choice challenge game as they GREATLY advertise(Google must do something about these misleading adverts), Instead it's a terrible, slow and quite impossible game to complete unless you have lots of coins. Just another money hungry game. Gameplay is slow and dull, not very captivating and no wow factor. You are left staring in to the games abyss thinking 'ok what's next'. I strongly urge the game developers to STOP misleading gamers. The game is about a butler looking after a garden.

I have enjoy playing this game. Storyline is interesting but it can take me ages to get through some very difficult levels. I cannot afford to buy coins so I can only keep on trying! I quite agree with the other players 900 coins for extra 5 moves is a lot and getting a level complete only get around 50+ coins as reward. Thanks for the lovely game and please don't make them too hard to play. I can play this game for hours. Thanks for the extra competitions which enable me to win the hours to play. Best game I have play. Thank you.

First off, the ads are completely fraudulent. Absolutely not what it advertises and is in fact a COMPLETELY different game... It's a candy crush style game with the task of building up a beautiful garden. But instead of building up your garden you're burdened with so many tasks to waste the points you get from beating the levels and you cant skip those irrelevant tasks..... the levels get so difficult and the mundane tasks cost more and more stars. Big waste of time and not even what the add is

i absolutely love this game. i've been playing it for four years now, and even though occasionally i've felt like i had to buy powerup bundles, i really like the gameplay and story. But lately i've had an issue; i'm using a 2015 Galaxy J5, and the phone is in good condition, but the game keeps freezing. I've updated everything, tried cleaning cache, restarting etc, but no matter what i do the game just won't load :( Is this something that might be fixed with the next update?

I've played this game before and it is pretty good which is why I am giving it stars, but its advertising is completely different from what it actually is. So anyone who comes with the intension playing a game of 'fixing things using the right equipment' would be naturally disappointed when they get a game where they need to play match to fix every damage there is. This misleading advertising is what cost the stars.

This is a very difficult rating, for one thing, if you have an obsessive or addictive personality stay extremely away. This game is rigged in lots of ways to try and frustrate you into spending money. Do not. Trust me it isn't worth it. If you think you can ignore the constant ways they ask for money, feel free to download it, but keep in mind. 1) Infinite lives are rigged, play for an hour max. 2)If you get stuck it's probably rigged, stop playing for a bit 3)levels get easier the less you play

Update: I have reached a point where I cannot solve a certain level (3086), so I have two suggestions for you to avoid my unistalling the game (I do not feel like playing anymore). 1) To give the player the chance to pass a level with 900 gold after, say, 100 attempts. 2) Do not increase the cost in stars of the goals when the game is more difficult! ! It's not logical, you frustrate the player. I wish you read this.

Loved it at first. Very addictive, but still waiting for the puzzle game? It became obvious after a while that the normal levels were made unusually difficult so you will spend your money. It's annoying when you are 1 move away from winning and you run out of moves. I spent over $20 in a week just to advance. In fact spending money is the only way to beat some levels. I uninstalled it when the money baiting became obvious. And Google play should do something about the misleading ad.

You guys should update combos. On most games you can combine 4 and get a bomb. Passing levels a lot harder and frankly a waste of my time. You don't give enough tries per level, all in all, this game is just a money grab. the levels are way too difficult, it's not fun spending months stuck on a level. I haven't been able to progress in a long time, just to complete a task requires way too many stars, and some of the tasks are plain stupid. why should it cost 2 stars to meet people. Uninstalled.

You can get quite far to be fair to gardenscapes before they cut the move count so much it makes the levels impossible without using in app purchases to continue. But level 304 was the limit for me. Passed this to friends and family to all try and they have the same conclusion, bait and switch type gameplay to get you hooked then force you to spend ££. Just charge me a one time fee for the game and make it 'fair', at least then the Devs/publisher would have had some money out of me. I'm out!

Edited review Just when you thought it couldn't get worse - it did! Now without warning they've removed the free energy timer in expeditions, allegedly to focus on match 3 levels but I've had none of those. So once I'm stuck on a level I'm stuck for the whole day or longer, with no possibility to earn. Game no longer fun. Losing things you've earned (or even paid for) just because you can't finish the level makes the game less enjoyable and completely unfair. Used to enjoy it, not any more

While the game is colorful and the graphics keep you engaged, the set up of this game leaves alot to be desired. You spend money for coins but when you beat a level the coins given back are less than what you spend for powerups. I feel this game is a huge money pit designed to compel you to spend your money, especially with hard levels. Other than what ive said I enjoy playing the game. I want to believe the makers that be will assess how yhey are pleasing pay customers.

I downloaded this game because it was advertised as something else. When I saw it's a mach-3 game I rolled my eyes but gave it a try. Some levels are so damn hard and some are too difficult. Also the daily prize wheel, never ever seen it. I was ready to uninstall untill the character got a dog. For dog's sake, I kept it. 2 stars because of false advertising and the developers goal is to get money out of your pocket, also link to download this game and that game, again with false advertisement...

Another money grabbing in-app purchase game :( It is playable for about a week without spending £2 or £3 on extras but after that becomes so funstrating you've had enough. The game has no skill progression; the only way to progress past higher levels is by purchasing extras. Terrible business practice of slipping low cost in-app purchases past you each day to progress. You could buy a PC or console AAA game for just a few days play.

Nothing like the ads. The annoying mini pop-up games with pins where you have to remove one to rescue a character... yes well that is fake. It does not feature in the real game at all. Real game is more like a cheap and painfully slow build your own village type game and you CANNOT make progress withOUT spending REAL money. Don't waste your time!

The game is good but I feel like this app is too greedy. We are allowed only 5 plays until it run out and have to wait for 30 mins to refill. This gets very frustrating considering the levels get harder and harder. And it always makes me feel like I have to pay money to get through. It is such a pity because the game could be good and addictive. I can stand a few adds for your revenue but I don't think it is worth paying money. I am uninstalling.

I downloaded it because I found the adverts for this game to be fun, only to find the game is a matching game and not like advertised! I already play homescapes and this is so similar it's not worth having/playing both, especially when it takes ages to pass the levels when you refuse to pay real money on an app. Overall it's ok, just not what I wanted.

My husband and my favorite game!! We play just about every night, for 7 year's!! Addictive, fun, interesting life & story, animal friends, awesome graphics & sounds (love GS theme music, this game is always turned up) very customizable & great personalities for all the characters!! It really has a way to bring you into the game & keep you going back! ** I know for a bit there Levels were to hard and we were having to pay for boosters every time we played but seems now they're back to normal!!

Level 12306 here and ready to stop. Have spent money on the game and used to love it, but it has just become impossible to move forward without spending any more money than I already do considering one doest not really get much for the money (expensive). Impossible to beat levels without boosters, and to make matters worse, no treasure hound any longer, just magic hats which we all know don't help much at the highest levels.

It's a good game and can be addictive, but some of the levels are really difficult and takes numerous tries to complete. The amount of stars needed for some of the tasks is ridiculous ! It seems a shame because people will get bored of not getting anywhere with the game and will uninstall it. Please take this into consideration and maybe make the tasks more accessible.
