The ads bated me with interesting puzzles to solve, but those appeared only during the first few rounds of play. I stopped playing because I came to a round where I spent about 50 USD to get through. Obviously, others had succeeded, but if I'm going to spend that much money, I'd rather just buy a game and play it....

I have been playing this for a while and I really enjoy the game but I think the events are too difficult to complete. I would like it if there were separate levels for the event instead of having to complete my current levels to earn points towards an event. I find the high levels to be quite challenging and so I am never able to beat enough to get an event completed. I tracked it once where I didn't spend stars focusing only on event points, had 72 stars and STILL hadn't finished the event.

I've been playing this game for years and I originally gave it 5 stars. But I've reduced that because some of the levels are ridiculously hard, I dont mind that too much as I like the challenge but when you need 2 or x 3 or 4 stars to do a task it gets frustrating. I also think that the cost of some of the event items and those in the special rooms are far too high. Seriously considering uninstalling the game

I used to truly enjoy this game, but at level 190+ (where I have literally spent MONTHS on trying to complete individual levels) the game is now honestly just pay to play. I don't mind spending actual money in a game, but when each level is costing $5.00 or more to just be able to complete it and move on to the next, it's honestly just not worth it to me anymore. I am going to be uninstalling this app today, and it makes me sad, but I am done with the overall cash sucking disaster its become.

It's no longer fun. I've spent more time playing levels over and over because they're too difficult to beat. You loose boosters easily. Once I beat a level or two then I'm stuck for days and days. I've bought a few golden tickets and the rewards are expensive to earn. To build your garden up takes too many stars and the adventure levels use way too many lightning bolts and offer little value in return. I'm no longer having fun.

Love this game have been playing for quite a while now and not bored yet. I agree with the many other reviews that some levels are extremely hard to complete without power ups which are expensive to buy. Love the side events they have made it five 🌟 game for me instead of a four 🌟. Keep making it interesting and I'll keep playing 😊........ A year on and have enjoyed the game and have spent a bit of money. But time to give it up, levels are too hard UNLESS you spend money. Bye

There are stages where you won't win until the game decides that you will. It's not skill, it's 101% "luck". So you have to wait until you get, say, 30 min of infinite lives and rush as many attempts at a level as you can. Some levels 100% force you to spend coins to get more lives. When the game doesn't do that, it's actually really fun. But that's so infuriating when it does, that it almost doesn't make up for it.

While it's an interesting game, it has a few irritating points. First off, their ads mislead you into thinking it's a survival game but in reality it's a item matching kind of game. 2nd, if you need an extra life to finish a game you have to pay as much as you pay for 5 lives. 3rd, some levels are just plain unfair, e.g: to eliminate butterflies, or dynamites etc. the game doesn't give you the required amount immediately, you have to waste a turn to make it happen. Please correct these dev!

I've been playing for almost 8 years and what drew me in was the smooth graphics and animations that made me feel cozy. After the last update everything is bright, ugly and plastic-looking and the new explosion animations are nauseating, not nearly as satisfying as before. The game now looks like a loud, aggressive slot machine and not chill and inviting like before. I could ignore it before but the imposing of in-game purchases has become more aggressive lately and it's really off-putting.

It is indeed a good game ,quite interesting and exciting for me! But lately I've been facing a weird issue today all day. I'm at level 2100+ and the game wouldn't allow me to play or do anything on screen! It is just stuck on one scenary with nothing to do about it. It is really annoying for me! I would appreciate an explanation and somehow a solution to my problem! Other than that, I appreciate the company's effort and creation. I do happen to enjoy their games.

Look at youtube video and you will see now there are often (maybe always) 6 less moves in the levels I checked. You must rely only on luck now. Its killing the game. No point of playing if the only way to pass the level is by buying bonuses... too bad... And please stop showing kids it's good to cut trees to put sculptures !!!

The game was fun at first. Then I only got to the level of the fountain, sweeping the yard, & planting the garden. Then all of a sudden there was no more duties, after completing the puzzles. And of a sudden the game almost impossible to go to the next level. They just want you to buy coins to keep going, even if it means making the levels difficult. It's clear it's a money making game. I prefer CSR racing 1&2 & Empires and allies & bubble pop & word puzzle. Disappointing.

I was enjoying the game until I came across some levels that are unbelievable. I surpassed 2 by restarting my phone, and a completely different level showed up. I am stuck on level 2117, which looks different from any walk through online. Tech support didn't help either. Uninstalled the game because I can't progress ahead. This sucks... I won't be trying any of the other playrix games.

I kept seeing ads for this and all its variations. The ads make it seem like it's a choose your way out of situations by giving you multiple options below the scenario. I haven't seen that yet in the game. It's basically a variation of candy crush with story telling. My one star rating is for the misleading ad. Totally not the game I expected or wanted.

This is a great game lots to keep you interested without any annoying ads. I have tried quite a few similar game's and this one is by far the best, the attention to detail and the ease of use is a real credit to the creator's. Generally I find characters in games to be tolerated but I actually enjoy the story part as much as the gameplay. Update... Still true however getting very greedy making it hard to pass levels without buying things and giving you less to help you .

Very confused as i downloaded this because liked the idea of the survival aspect. Presented 3 items must pick one to save them. But I'm lvl 50 now and not come across anything like that. Just candy crush style game to collect stars to then rebuild gardens. I was going to keep playing thinking the survival game part would be soon but from reading reviews now there isn't anything like that at all. Really bad false advertising.

Great game, spent lots of time playing and appreciate the lack of ads... HOWEVER... As stated by others in the review - DO NOT - I REPEAT - DO NOT EVER SPEND ANY MONEY ON THIS GAME. The minute you spend any sort of money on the game almost every level if not every other will become a hard/very hard/one shot challenge as a means to ensure you keep spending. Do not fall for the trap, the game stops being fun when you realize you're being extorted.

I played this game for years but my disappointment never escalated until recently. The level became harder than ever after the first time i purchased golden ticket. It seems like once you used real money, they made you HAVE TO use more by making the level more difficult. It makes me regretted purchasing that stupid golden ticket since it was a BIG WASTE. And now i feel like i shouldn't uninstall at least until the event is over. So disappointing 😒

This game is definitely addictive, but it doesn't get a 5 star since it has false adverts. In the adverts it doesn't show you Austin, or in the real game you can't help people survive. I downloaded the game because of it's adverts. But if I have to be honest it is A SUPER GAME, in my perspective it's better that the ads but it's not what some people want. Plus it says HELP THEM, but in the game there is not 5% ( or less ) of helping in the game.

It's a good game when you can get a good run. But being at the higher levels, every level is hard or superhard. Or, the pointless pink levels that are just there to ensure you lose your boosters. Most of the levels you need to pay to get through it, and even then having all 3 boosters isn't enough. Rubbish. So many times I open the game and I suddenly get a time of free game play, but that's not always a time I can play, so it's wasted. Pointless to have a game you can't play. Deleting.

False advertising! Don't download if you came here after seeing the ads! I downloaded this game after seeing what looked like an interesting puzzle solving game on the ads, where you choose the correct multiple choice option to overcome an obstacle, or pull levers in the right order to reach a goal. The actual game is just another Bejewelled/Candy Crush wannabe. I've uninstalled it.

I have played this game for quite awhile found it to be frustrating at times as some levels were so hard to beat. Every time there are more and more files to download my tablet would freeze and it got to where it was affecting my other games by freezing them also. So because of these issues I had to delete the game. It didn't affect another tablet identical to my tablet but I will also be deleting it from there also.

False advertising! This is a crappy Candy Crush style match 3 game with "buy this thing to make your garden look pretty". This is not a game of "pick this item to save the burning house", or " save these characters on an island", or "pull this pipe to save the butler from the spider..." So why advertise it as such??? DON'T DOWNLOAD IT!!! You're agreeing to give your data to something that is not what you were looking for!

Downloaded cuz I saw ads of the fun minigames, it is appearantly just a match puzzle, if the ratio was aight would've kept it. Played 15 puzzles (only 1 of the advertised minigames in the beginning) before I gave up on waiting for more minigames. Game is what it is, I'm just disappointed since it's not at all as the advertisements I've seen.

Still waiting for the part of the game that grabbed my attention in the ad. Did not expect the game to be a gem matching game. The algorithms used are so blatantly formed to coerce people into spending money on the game that I don't know how long it will keep me interested for. I have spent money on games before, but this hard push through game manipulation leaves a bad taste in my mouth. That being said, the garden graphics are great and the little story lines are fun.

I do like the game very much. The custard & bubbles/suds are annoying as they form very quickly & there isn't enough lives etc. When it's the dogs exercising how come if we lose one we have to go back to the start which isn't fair. Also when we get unlimited lives, it would be a good thing if we could save it, so we can go back to it when we like. Apart from that I do enjoy playing it, it's relaxing!

I'm on level 1616. I used to love this game but now it just frustrates me. The supposedly normal levels are actually hard and the one I'm on now is supposed to be done in 18 moves. There are also lots of pointless tasks that use up our stars like calling people or redoing things we've already built. And as for completing a level, I feel like ive wasted my time because it could take me 20 times to finally pass and only to be rewarded with like 50 gold coins. Please improve game.

I've been playing this game for 8years and every new update ruins a part of the fun game I originally started playing. Barely any decorations are changeable and you now can't even restart a level without losing your power ups. It just is not the game it used to be, along with the insane algorithm of the game play that only allows you to win if and when it chooses, the game just isn't as fun as it used to be.

Very worst game. It shows puzzles game in ads, I downloaded it after seeing that ad, like it would be great to solve puzzles like games and I downloaded. Played upto 65th level, but only 2 puzzles came in that. Also, can't able to go after the level 65. Very very worst, it made us to download by showing wrong ads. Also, it's asking for payment to buy coins.. I thought to give 0, but if I need to comment I had to give 1 star..🤦

It used to be very enjoyable game. But after few updates and changes by the developer, the game has become very stressful, the reward coins reduced, but coins for extra life to continue remain unchanged, that's just not right. Also as commented by another gamer, when we try to re-enter the stage at 2nd time, all the booster n life are "used" when I didn't even start the previous level. Coin purchase has become so expensive. This new updates will leads to losing loyal players.

Feel like i get stuck on each level, i'm achieving nothing fast. the chests used to be easier to get to the best one, now it takes longer. The graphics have always been really good, i luv watching the water. Its kinda funny to train a horse on this compared to a real one. i wish it was that easy in real life. Thanks gardenscapes but i'll be signing out for the last time

I enjoy the game but it is really annoying that you get stuck on hard and superhard levels of the game for days on end. You get about 2-3 easier levels and then you're stuck again for ages. I have been stuck on this level a couple of days. Might as well uninstall the game. Playing the extra area, Flower Shop. The board is filled with things I can't use, trying to get things that I can use. Nearly have no room to play now but I can get rid of anything. Stupid.

Have been playing this game since COVID 19 lockdown. It was fun back then. Currently at 8416 and it gets frustratingly annoying after level 8000. I run out of lives 3-4 times daily to beat every alternate level, avg 5-7 days per level. You must buy add ons else you can't make it through a sane mind. it's pure time waste if you're not paying. Now I'm not interested anymore. Unistalling this game to invest some quality time in a real life. Wasted too much of money and time into this game.

After playing for 6+ years i might delete the game after all. It's nearly impossible to pass a level without using power ups (even with them it's still hard to pass one) or spending gold for more moves (almost every time im one move away from finishing the level). Also there is no more treasure hunt only magic hats that bring way less rewards.. You ruined the game so much, it brings only stress when it was made to relieve one...

Sorry guys but this game is impossible.You should learn from King. Candy crush is still so addictive after so many levels. Is the perfect balance between paying and passing through levels on your own. Your levels are to hard and some almost impossible if you are not using perks at the beginning of the level. I have the feeling that this game was created with the sole purpose that we should pay to pass the levels. It's a shame because it can be a very good and funny game.

The review you see and what the game actually is, is deceiving. It's something like candy crush and u earn couns to fix up the garden. No solving a getaway. No maize! The game is nothing like what is advertised. Waste of my data downloading. Dont waste your time and data people. The garden and home one too is the same and fishdome.....all a big catch. Very disappointing!

I loved playing the game and spent many hours completing the garden areas on both sides now since moving to the third the levels are nearly impossible to pass unless I want to spend money! I quit playing for a year and really would like to play, but if the levels don't get any easier I will just delete the game😢

I play this game for a long time now and I recently purchased the Golden Ticket to progress faster and get more out of playing. Turns out that I wasted my money. Every third level is a hard one and I am stuck for days with no gold or items. Clearing lvls turns into a thing of luck, eventhough I spent actual money on this game which should give me an advantage, at least a small one, somehow. I also got the wrong event recently. It's frustrating and I will probably stop playing soon.

This game is an example of how gambling addiction begins and why it's an endless cycle. You have to keep on purchasing items within the game to keep this inane garbage going on. If I could I would have given it zero ratings. Don't spend your hard earned money on buying game coins to achieve a goal that has absolutely zero achievement in real life.

Money grabbing game. It was great in the beginning but after getting into pass first level or garden you have to play games for every single task. The game even make unnecessary tasks so you can spend more money. Like a cat mysteriously get stuck up a tree and you have to pay for that. Then they are tasked that you have to do twice because the first one wasn't good enough. Example the fountain. I got it done but then the pump didn't work even after I played to get it fix up the first time.

I have a love/hate relationship with this game. It's a great time killer and fun, but sometimes the Hard or Super Hard levels are ridiculously impossible without powerups. But, if it were all easy I probably wouldn't play it anymore because it would be boring. I'm at level 721 after just 2 months. seriously, you can become an addict waking up at 2am when your lives refill just to play again.

Love this game so much and have been playing it for a very long time now! The only thing that drives me nuts is when it seems like the game is trying to prevent you from beating a level. I'll often get to where I should easily be able to finish a level on the first try, but then the fireworks just seem to "forget" to go for the right pieces, or no more acorns will drop (or whatever the requirements are to fulfil) for the last 5 moves. Otherwise, I'm on lvl 1695 and I haven't spent a dime!

I really like this game, but over time it becomes a bit boring to play games with the same pattern on each level (even with different levels of difficulty). I hope the developer will add some short games options as alternative, or maybe make a different type of game for each level (like puzzel, find objects, find the differences, problem solving, logic, etc.)

Always love these games, have played them all but this one is challenging. Just when you think you might pass the level your out of turns. I have been stuck on some levels for days before advancing. I am a little frustrated on the special events because I can never get very far, the higher levels are much more challenging puzzles. Amazing graphics and always new areas!

Great game. Been playing for about the whole time it's been around. Never paid anything extra for help with any level ever. I like that the developers keep introducing new bits and pieces although do not like all of them. Please get rid of the gas boxes recently brought in and what happened to the timed levels. They were great! Only problem is with the updates. Tend to get issues for a few weeks after each one. My phone told me to unistall as there had been 10 major errors in the last week caused by this programme and it was making my system run super slow. I would also add that the updates are enormous. I'm on the verge of deleting it as I just do not have storage capacity on my phone. If I had nothing else on it then it would be fine but like most people I have various other apps and photos etc. This game is just getting too big and to be honest some of the stuff being updated is unneccesary. The graphics seem to change every update and I don't know why. They were fine 2 years ago. If isn't broke don't fix it. I haven't played for 2 weeks now as it is waiting for me to update and needs me to get rid of 5 other apps to do so, all of which I have use for. Seriously considering deleting 2500 levels worth of progress. It's a shame.

I like the idea of combining two different games into one. But the game is really slow in two ways. First it's literally slow. It takes 30 seconds to go from one level to another. Second the progress of decoration is also slow. I played more then 200 levels but I only decorated 2 gardens. There are very unrelated tasks that you have to complete rather than decorating and it takes a lot of time.

I'm updating my review from 2016 to adjust the new updates of the game. I always have a lot of fun with this game and I appreciate the difficulty in levels. I am very displeased with these new "challenge" levels. These levels are impossible to beat without putting all boosters on and even then it isn't guaranteed. If you don't use any boosters and lose you also lose ALL of your progress from the hat or the chest which then puts you back at square one. It's getting quite annoying.

Advertising needs to be honest. I downloaded the game thinking it was puzzle sorts. But it's just another candy crush with some playing around with the garden. Plus I am stuck where I am forced to buy a garden decoration compulsorily. It just doesn't have option to close the popup. For getting a puzzle which appears once in a long while, you have to play candy crush all the while and decorate garden, that's not something you show in the ad. Deleting it.

It's was fun at first but I find the pace for developing the garden way too slow. Even if you buy items for an event you basically have have to put your life aside to collect all the perks (and you may still not make it in time) which is ridiculous. I'd gladly pay for the game outright but with all in app purchase games when I do the math on the cost over time I could buy a small house over the course of a of couple of years... Even with the regular "discounts".

2017: After playing this for quite a while I can definitely say it's addictive. The only drawbacks, for me, is I would rather be able to replay levels because some of them are pretty cool and eventually they get repetitive. And it would be more motivating if it didn't take a million stars to do every little task. Also, I sometimes start hoping Austin gets run over by one of the passing vehicles. Edit 2023: ugh

Three stars should be awarded for super-hard levels, two for hard levels and one for ordinary levels. Reduce the number of stars required to carry out a task. 4/5 is way too many especially when there are two stages to some tasks. It's also really annoying that you can't decide when to use the free lives bonuses, they are applied immediately to your game. It would be great if these could be saved for use at a later time

i used to like this game so much because it's fun, and i could not wait to unlock the new past of the garden. but lately, i have mostly stuck in one level for quite sometimes, and finding out how sometimes even the most powerful power up does not work at all, it's a waste of time, power ups and annoying. not to forget the coin is still hard to collect, only when the dog training the coins i get is doubled. i hate it when the coin for decoration set is bigger than the coin i collect from each level. i used to rate 4.5 stars but now am sorry if i had to rate the game 2 stars only.

At first this was a really fun game with a lively theme. The story was fun and seeing the garden evolve was a great incentive to keep playing. But then tasks became petty and the levels more difficult. In the end I deleted the game after being stuck at one level for a month. This is not fun or relaxing. By the way the ads for this game have no connection to it at all!

I've had this game for over 4 years now and I really love it. It's one of the best (with Homescapes) match3 Ive played and I've tried many but I keep getting back. The game pieces, bonuses and boosts are nice and clear and easy to see and recognise. One minus is the notifications for the event and mini events. I don't care for the added "boat race" but I'm forces to watch the "here is how you lost" snippet.

False advertising! While the game itself is a pretty decent match-3 game where you earn "energy" to make yor garden prettier, there are no trace of the levels shown in pop-up ads for this game shown in other apps. If you expect "catastrophe" or "escape" levels, you will be disappointed. I would easily give 5 stars for the decent implementation of the match-3 genre but give only three because of their deceptive ads. I will modify my score when I see true ads for this game.

Since the last update I have not been able to send or ask for lives. I've contacted customer support on numerous occasions and have had no response. It asks me to save my progress which I have but my name has disappeared. Nothing seems to be working! I have unistalled and reinstalled the game 3 times but it's still not fixed. I have a Samsung galaxy S10 that is up to date so its not that. I have spent a lot of money, time and effort on this game and I'm so annoyed that I haven't had any contact!

The good thing of this game is that it has beautiful graphic and that's it!! The gameplay is so bad. You will have to wait like 25 minute to get a life if you fail. Some of the levels are impossible to beat without boosters which cost thousands, but you only get about 60 dollar after you beat a level, and beating levels is the only way to get money beside spending real money. I have been stuck around level 78 for ages! Goodbye gardenfreakingscapes!

The game is certainly addicting, but definitely needs some balancing between cost and reward. This game is the perfect example of pay-to-win. I win 50-60 coins for completing a level, but need a minimum of 900 to get a booster? It's just not fair. If the boost cost 90 instead or so (or anything that wouldn't require me to win 18 games first) it would be much more reasonable.

I really enjoy this game, but echo many of the other reviews - the levels are too hard for the rewards & extra moves / power ups etc cost too much. But, they have improved the events & rewards for them, so that's something. Frustratingly addictive! This game is getting boring - same competitions week after week, same mini-events, back-to-back & the Season events are a bit predictable. I dont play much anymore.

It's a really good game play- however! It's so expensive! The base game is easy, you can reach everything nicely without the need of pay. But the new add ons are cost a fortune. You cannot finish 1 project without paying for boosters and stuff. Now the game is so overcrowded with extras that I can't enjoy anymore. If there would be an option for turn off these extra events, I would. I used to play with this game hours a day. Now I hardly play 1 hr a month. That's why I give only 4 stars.

I see the game still takes forever to load. Fix it and I would love to play it again. Back to homescapes only. This next one is for both homescapes and garden. I really dislike that the game constantly shows you the lock box everytime, as well as the level up on the side games. Like really we can go in and see for ourselves. Please take it aeay from popping up ALL THE TIME. THANKS

It used to be really good and I didn't mind spending some cash on this game but it's just straight up sabotaged at higher levels. When challenges are up you always end up being short of time or stuck on levels (or both!) at which time there's always a "convenient" sale happening where you can buy event extenders. I've decided to no longer spend money on this app because of it.

Very addictive, but the constant addition of new in-game events is actually too much. I just want to play the levels, not be continually urged to buy golden tickets, redecorate something, or install Homescapes as well. And it's pretty clear that the game increasingly wants you to pay for boosters to get through levels. Not sure how much longer I'll keep playing. *update* I am sick and tired of the constant in-game badgering to download Homescapes. Please give the option to turn these off.

I like this game...BUT...there are too many difficult levels. I like a challenge...But...I spend days trying to get through levels and the reward is cheap. I am considering Quitting the game. It would be a good plan for you to watch the ads that are on this game.. I was playing at about ten oclockish at night and there was an xrated ad that popped up...NOT Impressed. Hello again I like some of the new changes, they are nice, but I am not thrilled with the "have to buy the coins" with real money. Getting coins is difficult at best, but the changes make it almost impossible. Also why is it so hard to get the shovels.. and why are the hearts taken out of the wheel??? When the game gets too difficult or starts to require real money for too many things People quit the game... this is a good game!!!

I used to enjoy this game immensely, it has nice graphics, fair "plot" and interesting game mechanics. It's really good at keeping you in suspense about the next areas of the game (yet to be unlocked by you). Unfortunately, recent marketing of the game is just abysmal at best and overall degrades the quality significantly. I really wish that game marketing team would come to their senses and stopped false advertising.
like the rest of the Ai or computer ran games, its only fun for a few levels then the amount of progress you can make or fun you have is directly tied to how much you spend. Game gets an F

This game is highly addictive! But I think slightly more coins should be awarded for passing a level. I also hate the one time challenge levels! They are not beneficial, only a disadvantage. They just stuff up your win streak and most of them are made to fail and IMPOSSIBLE to pass without using multiple types of costly boosts. You should get a CHOICE if you want to attempt the challenge level or skip and continue ahead like normal.

The only thing I liked about the game was the fact you could decorate your house while playing 3-match games. Back then it was a pretty new concept. However, it's again the kind of game they make too hard to play without spending money or becoming immensely frustrated. Not to mention they, like mindless sheep, decide to use false adverts like all others. If you can't haul in players without it, you're no good as developers. If your game was like the ad, I'd rather play it, it'd be actual fun.

I played it for 2 years and it is a money stealer. The levels have a certain pattern in which it forces you in the corner to spend some cash or die. The same level is super hard the first time and super easy the next time. It's hard to prove money making algorithms but make the experience much worse. I really liked the game but I will stay away now from all their games. So I deleted Homescapes too.

Too hard to be fun!! Starts off OK and the game idea is great but after a while the levels get too hard and starts to become either expensive or frustrating, at 1 point I had to clear ice, boxes, match next to some flower pots to make flowers to win and only get limited moves!! They either need to get rid of the limited moves or make the goals easier to achieve! You have to be lucky or rich to succeed in this game! I've got no problem spending a little on a good game but I'm not throwing it away when the game isn't even setting realistic standards. After writing this I am deleting the game, I would consider getting it again of they made it more fun to play rather than just frustrating! Also 2 stars to complete a task such as calling someone is ridiculous!

Adverts are extermely misleading. It's a Candy Crush style game with a nice renovating bit between levels. No pull the pin or anything out of the ordinary. The game becomes pay to win after a few levels as none of the power ups given to you come close to completing levels. The music's lovely though. Daryl Whitney Jr.'s review is suspicious as it throws shade on other players, and tries to discredit the pay to win problem that most of the reviews agree on. (Just sayin').

It was totally false advertising. Every ad is about chosing an option and even the app's pics on the play store are about choices. I downloaded the game twice and it had not a single option like in the ads appeared. Truley dissapointing. Maybe if there is a separate game with the choices, and there wasn't any false ads, then I would really like this game. I'm not saying the game is bad, it is just very misleading.

Addictive. Don't get your Hope's up, this is absolutely nothing like the advert. More like candy crush. It is well drawn and the garden animations are done very well but they are pointless. You can just do the puzzles and not bother upgrading the garden. You get 5 lives then they want you to but more but you can wait or you can get up to 3 hours free play if you choose to do tasks or beat certain levels with the competitions. I played for 6 months before realising I was wasting far too much time

The ads are very misleading! I was hoping for more of what your ads showed but because I like match up games it ended up being a fun and addictive. Now it's just frustrating as hell, I play games like this to relax not to be aggravated. I am not very far into the game because I literally cant get anywhere without spending real money to advance. Not something I would recommend to anyone. 50-100 coins for completing a level what a joke, especially when everything you need to advance is MUCH more!

Slightly addictive, very repetitive. The game itself is NOTHING at all like advertised. It's advertised as a puzzle game, solving various survival scenarios, however, the actual game just another Candy Crush clone, albeit with a bit of a story to push the progress along. Story is annoying and very, unnecessarily long cut scenes. Try it, play it, but you'll end up uninstalling it.

Fun addictive casual game. Unless you spend real money on boosters, once you go above level 2000 be prepared to spend days stuck on a level. Also the pop ups when you start the game can be tedious, some times i have to close out four popups promoting some drivel before i can actually play. They pop up one at a time after you close the other one so it feels unending. Oh, and the required updates are too big and too frequent.

Please consider removing the decrease of points for season events when there is a failed attempt. It's hard enough to pass levels and it gets expensive to proceed (most require boosters and coins to pass). Especially when you pay for gold pass, i think points should not be decreased when a level is failed. I support in-app purchases for a well-made game; but it is getting expensive and not fun to play.

This game is designed specifically to drain money from your credit card. The AI is rigged, so that any power ups you either win consecutively through beating levels, or through payment, are wasted - most land in dead spots where you're forced to use them. It is a game that is almost entirely luck based, with no real strategic sense of achievement. There is no real definition between normal, hard and super hard levels - a player can spend days or weeks stuck on a level regardless. Overall, 1/5

Downloaded the game based on the ads shown and expected it to be something like puzzle. But it was nothing like the ad. Apart from that, when i started playing, i realised that i earn a small number of coins at end of a level, ie 50-60 and need a whopping 900 coins for extra moves. Nothing like i expected. Hard levels to ensure one ends up spending money to buy lives/other resources. Very disappointed. Will uninstall it in a while.

At some point you will get stuck indefinitely (whatever the few who say otherwise imply.) Usually after being stuck on a level for ages, the game makes it easy to complete that level; to keep you interested and playing. However there will be a point that this no longer happens and you will need to pay to progress. I've been at that point for weeks now so uninstalled.

I really love this game because of the difficulty balance of the levels; some of the levels are frustratingly hard but some others are fairly easy! That way, the game doesn't keep us frustrated after finishing every level especially on higher levels. I do buy coins when they have discounts because I keep spending them on power ups and shovels. I wish the lucky spin has more valuable prizes!

I have been enjoying the game, even though it's not the one I thought I was getting. (Was meant to save fish). But now I am finding the levels impossible to pass, even though I ve played candy crush for years, and a am on a level way over 2000. The challenges are impossible to pass also. Time runs out while your still stuck on the same level. I will be uninstalling this game very shortly.

The garden scenes drag on, you cant just skip.. very annoying. easy levels are 10 x harder than the hard levels! you get stuck, forcing you to spend money . Or play the same 40x. Its blatantly rigged to run out of moves with 1 move left. boosts, when you finally earn them, land in useless places. Or in place of a piece which could have been a bomb. I've been playing this game for years, im on lvl 4000 + and this is only been happening in the last year. Fix please or I'm gone.

It may seem fun, but it is designed to use up you coins and not let you win levels. The Reason? To get you to spend money on the Game. There suggestions every few levels to spend. Nope. if one watches the way the vines and lava increase speed to block you, it is easy to see the game is design to get you to use and buy coins. Yeah if you count a hundred tries per level....

Finally uninstalled the game after 2 years. Finally had enough of levels that are not do able until the algorithm allows. Originally got the game because the ads showed the mini games but they soon stopped, after a few weeks at most, but the game was addictive. I grew more & more frustrated with the fact the game is setup to try & entice people to spend real money. Bottom line the game was fun but rigged. Very little skill required. Lots of luck needed.

Great game but some levels are impossible. I'm at a high level and has been playing for a few months. I enjoy the game. But sometimes there are levels that are impossible to pass without purchasing bombs etc. Making you have to pay to buy bombs etc. I think it's unfair to create a level that is not passable without having to purchase additional product. I've purchased coins a few times, but I'm tired of it now. I'll just move on to another game until their ai decides to make the level playabl

First off - the ads are incredibly inaccurate, particularly the one that says it is. This is a matching game not a puzzle game. Secondly - I played this games YEARS ago and it was great. It is now a money grab and annoying to get through all the other ads The bonuses are expensive for game that boasts itself to be one thing in which it's not and provides ads that are too frequent. It's not even playable to the point it's even enjoyable or worth spending money on. Not worth your time or $.

Started off great, but just like all your games eventually you have to pay to pass a level. The game would be much more enjoyable if the levels weren't so hard, but obviously the bottom line is that you make money. So by making the levels that hard to pass that you need to buy stuff just to pass it, you win and you get your $$. I'll be deleting this game along with all your others. What's the point of having unlimited lives when you can't pass the level your on. Not every1 has $ to spend.....

If you are planning to download the game for the puzzle games, then don't waste your time, these are misleading ads. You will only come across a puzzle every 20 or so level and it's not even good. As for the game it's like candy crash game, but the levels are designed that you after certain levels you have to pay real money to get preks to help you clear the levels, because they can't win within the turn limits, so you'll need to keep spending money on it over and over again to continue or else

Not a bad game. This is a symbol matching game with each level giving stars to upgrade your house and garden. It's definitely not without its charm. Shame this is nothing like what i thought i was getting from the ads in other games. Also some of the levels are ridiculously hard and the only way to gain enough coins is to spend money. No ad watching, no replaying earlier levels, just cold hard cash. Uninstalled, won't be playing again.

Played the game for a while and then uninstalled due to the fact that the game sucks, takes 3 days to play 1 level because of difficulty. Reinstalled about a year later and I'm going to uninstall again, was just now reminded why I uninstalled the 1st time. This is supposed to be fun but instead just frustrates the hell out of a person. I refuse to spend any money on this app therefore you want to make it impossible to proceed without spending my money. That's it, thanks for turning something that should've been a great way to relax and enjoy turning it into one of the most frustrating game ever. Same with Homescapes. Thanks for wasting my time.

Been playing this game for well over a Year (Level 1612) It's been favourite. But the longer i play the more harder it gets, I expect it to challenge you the more you progress but it's just become insane been stuck on the same level for over a week not even a hard rating level. So time to say goodbye to it. Completely taken the fun out of the game.

Uninstalled it once, but get tempted to install it again after reading the better review of updated version. It was a better version. Another update has been installed, but have no idea what's new in it, as the same issues still remaing. Such as: too many uncessary tasks that aren't related to fixing the garden, which wasting the stars. Power up that too expensive. Waiting too long for fill up the lives. Last updates is the worst (30/6/20). Game keep pausing and lost its music. Very annoying 🥴

I've enjoyed this game for years and playing just for the fun of it, not caring about events and not stressing over being promoted/demoted to another league. However, the decorations - it is impossible to earn enough cash to complete unique decoration sets in specific areas. They are just too expensive. The game creators goal is to spend real money in the game, which I have no intention of doing. I am on level 1500+ and have yet to see a mini game. Stop pushing us to install your other game!

Great graphics and could be 5 star but I would like to be able to move to other garden areas without "finishing" (over decorating) one first, and to be able to play different games to get there. It's possible to level up without spending $ but this can mean playing the same game over and over again which gets BORING. If you do choose to spend $ then you don't get your money's worth. Lots of potential but way too repetitive for me with low payoff. Be fun to have some dark decoration options, too.

O boy, just when you think you can give a new and better review, the game comes and do this. I have been playing this game since 2016. And I am thinking of deleting the profile and entire game from my device. Getting stuck on levels for days on end, getting 3hours of free live, but not winning a level in that time. 🤬 Spending a lot of money and not getting levels. Fix it, or your going to loose players.

Extremely misleading advertising. This isn't a puzzle game at all. The game is just a glorified version of Candy Crush. After a few levels it's practically impossible to gain enough credits without sittinf through some idiotic ads just to get the moves necessary to finish the level and get your points. You should be ashamed of the misleading nature of your ads, they aren't even remotely close to what the game is.

For some reason, my game stopped working yesterday; it just simply won't load...it just gets stuck on the loading bar and I've waited for over 10 minutes yet nothing :-( I'm on about level 1400, it's taken a lot of effort (and impulsive purchases to have those extra 5 moves) but, I can honestly agree that it's an addictive game (not addicting by the way...) I'll try to uninstall and reinstall again, hopefully I won't lose everything :-S

OK so like my review on homescapes I love the game but the puzzles are very hard to complete and it takes the fun out of it like with homescapes. It's not enjoyable because of this it's just pure frustration and the lives well u don't get a lot of them. I am not paying real money to buy things on it and in app currency it's still expensive when it comes to buying extra lives etc. So please make the puzzles a bit easier. Because at the moment I'm not playing it much.

The game is great but one major frustration concerns saving one's progress during the minigames. Typically, I can start a match 3 minigame, be interrupted and come back to it. However, it has happened a couple of times where I've been playing, got interrupted and when I've come back, I've lost my place in the minigame, lost a life and any boosters I had as well. That's ridiculous to be so penalised for coming out of the game. Developers please sort this out!

Wonderful game, lives take too long to renew though. Can the time possibly be lessened? Thanks PLAYRIX. Also, it would be good if the moves that are left after a game is won, be brought forward to the following level. For eg. I had won a level using 4 or 5 moves with 24 moves left, i lost all those moves - wasn't cool at all. This needs some serious consideration Playrix, as some levels don't have a lot of moves. Next, more coins at the end of game would be great - too little coins given. Why???

The game is perfect. I love this game very much. But when I synced my last game on other device to my Android mobile, type "OK" and press ok, my game is stuck and freezed. I can't do anything but only clear task and run game again. And then my game has been synced. Would you fix this bug, please? It's only occurred on Android Mobile. My iPad can press ok and app is not freezed.

Being able to customise the garden is the main draw, and keeps me constantly wanting to go back and play to finish up decoration. Only 3 stars because the levels are too difficult - I need at least 30 to 50 tries on average to pass them now, which may lead to the downfall of this game. As it is, I stop playing daily, instead I play other more interesting games, and only returnn to GS once in 2 to 4 weeks, more often longer. This will be the downfall of GS

Such a nice and fun game! BUT... the levels are to hard, even the ones that are not marked as hard, you can play them for days. There are to many stars you need to collect for a just small part of task. And of course if you want to pass the levels, you need to buy boosts... which you get rarely for free. It would be such a nice game if it is easier.

It's definitely not as advertised. You don't get to choose options to get out of bad situations. Instead you need to go through countless levels of cheap 'candycrash' to get 1 star per 1 level so you can complete gardening tasks. Hard to do without spending tones of money. Graphics are nice but overall it gets boring quickly. Wouldn't recommend. a

Overall it's a funny game with good graphics and simple gameplay. It's not directly a p2w but you can spend lots of money on this game which bothers me a bit. It also crashed a few times without saving the level. When that happened the boosters I used in that level were gone but the level wasn't saved as successfully done! Some bug fixes would be nice!

OK, first off, don't believe the ads. It's just a match game, not a puzzle game (pull the correct pin sequence/choose the right item to save or survive, they are not in the game). I installed it for that reason, but nothing has shown, and never will according to playrix's own user forum. On saying all this, it is a fun match game that you don't have to spend any money on. Dialogue/cut scene can be time consuming, but there is a skip button on most. Fun time waster, but not as advertised.

Great finish to a nice game by very greedy company. Let me explain. Graphics are sweet, a nicely drawn set with detailed characters and garden pieces. There's a storyline that you can follow, but the transitions between scenes is a tad too slow. The main reason for playing is the puzzle side of the game. It works great, but has a few flaws. The thing is, it's designed so you always end up with one move short. Pay up and you get more, or for power-ups. Irritating, but you get over it as you go.

Installed the game and wasn't happy that it was completely different to play than the advertisment made out. But I gave it a go and managed to make it through to a level in the 200s(?) while refusing to buying any extra items, super frustrating at times with the really hard levels. But now the game won't start at all! keeps saying "connection lost" and that I need to connect to the internet for it to load.... there is nothing wrong with my internet! I guess I will be uninstalling!

Two problematic issues. You cannot skip the speech bubbles. I'm a quick reader, I don't need to take a break between each letter to let my brain process it. I've read it and understood, is it so hard to let me read the next bit? Also, pay to play stinks. I know that many apps and games like this offer the option to let you pay to speed things up a little (thats fine). It gets to a point on this where you MUST purchase such power ups to proceed. Nice graphics though, gets a star for them.

Contacted support to report an issue on Tortuga event in great detail with pictures. Was missing just 3 things from total completion of the event. In the end their response was that there was no issue and ended the conversation. Apperantly making 99,9% of the event with more than enough time to spare and making the report on time, there can be "no" issue. Sure I like to waste my time reporting problems and not finish what I started (screenshot of my progress was included in the report) 1 star

I've been playing this game for a while now, having completed over 2,600 levels now. Overall, I enjoy it. Fun, graphics are good. However, I am getting a bit fed up with nearly every other level now being super hard, and the rewards being less than brilliant. I don't want dollars for completing them, nor do I want dollars for growing the bonsai tree. I want more boosters. I've got around $20,000 dollars, with nothing I want to spend them on. At least give us the option to exchange them for boosters instead of for decorations that I really don't want. Thank you

I had a wonderful bonus of 4 hours of unlimited lives. Thought this would be great to help complete the Christmas decorations. I spent the ENTIRE 4 hours trying to conquer 1 level. Needless to say I am frustrated. This is supposed to a fun game. When one spends all of the unlimited live time on 1 level, that is just rated hard, the fun is lost. ps It would be great if a person could bank some of the unlimited life time. 4 hours of continuous play is a waste.

Not sure why people complain it's hard, or think they have to pay money to pass. I can be stuck on a level for 2-3 days, unlike CC where I could be stuck for a week or more. Use the boosters wisely and it's fine. Fun and amusing game, occassionally mis reads the swipe (possibly just requires calibration of touch sensor) Update: seems to miss combos, or gives unexpected combos when explosions happen.

I've had this game for a couple of years now - the actual game isn't bad, although the hard levels are difficult to pass unless you spend money to get upgrades. The 1 star rating is based purely on the advertising; it's not at all the choice escape game that you see in the ads. It's a Candy Crush type game where you beat levels to help a butler improve his garden. Very misleading/disappointing, and I'll be uninstalling on this alone. Not going to support an app that thinks that's okay.

App is nothing like the ad, which showed a game where you solve puzzles / brain teasers. Instead, it's a Candy Crush copy, with the addition of doing tasks the more levels you pass. After a certain level, the game gets impossible - unless you purchase help! I'm itself the game works fine. If anything, a bit slow once you pass a level to move on, even after you tap the screen, it takes a few seconds to move on.

levels are way to hard to beat when you get higher up. you have to spend a week or more just to pass one level. all they will say is that there is tips on our website to help each level but those still dont work. there are way to many extra hard levels. please make it easier to relax and enjoy the game rather than get frustrated because you only needed to collect two more things but ran out of moves. Same problem with homescape. going to delete both soon.

Nothing like the ads. The ads on socials draw you in thinking it'll be super fun, quickly realize it's not like that at all.. Okay I'll give it a shot.. But once you get a few "levels" in, it's absolutely impossible to beat. The tutorials make you use up your boosters all at once so you have nothing left for the hard levels. It's just a ridiculous game. 100% not worth the storage it takes up or the battery life it drains.

Game is wonderful, challenging and cute. My garden looked beautiful. Then I uninstalled. It was fun and challenging, until it became ridiculously difficult. Levels became too hard to complete with one star per level even when things cost three stars. They are all beatable, I know, but it's all up to luck. I was also a bit disappointed that the developers had zero confidence in there game. False advertisements aren't nice.

False advertising... A good game; great graffics, story line, characters, challenges, and developer involvement. But I no longer play. If you've followed here from an ad, know that the actual game is NOTHING, repeat NOTHING, like the ad/s, & why I've stopped playing. I am sick & tired of seeing the ads that differ so extremely from the actual game. It's a match 3 game; collect a star from a level and use it to clear a challenge that lets you choose the colour of flowers. That's it.

Can be enjoyable BUT some levels are ridiculously difficult. I have lost count of the amount of lives I have used trying to get through the level I'm on now. The bombs come to late. Also nothing like the advert which has annoyed me, you don't get to choose items to solve a problem it's all match 3 or more games to carry out tasks. VERY close to uninstalling!

False Advertisement. You were shown to do different thing on the ad but when installed, its just like candy crush but harder since each time you have to earn a star to complete a challenge. I played this before but because of the ad showing a different kind of game that I like, I downloaded it again. But nothing changed and what's showing on the ad isn't there at all.

Unistalling. First: The advertising is lying to us. Completely. The game is about something totally different. Second: It's is a quite entertaining game but they made it in a way you would have to expend a lot of money if you want to continue the levels. After level 74 or so, the game is impossible to success without the bonuses, which you won't use only one per level, probably 2 or 3. I would recommend to read all the bad comments before download it.

Stuck on level 1382 for months now. A tutorial video on YouTube shows there should be bombs under some of the boxes but I cannot find any, so for me that level is impossible to solve. The helpdesk told me they change levels from time to time (which in itself is ridiculous), so they must have changed this level for the worse! No help from them at all! Uninstalled! edit: I'm on level 1382, I do know how to play this game! but this level is impossible because you changed it!

Overall, it's a decent game but it has its issues. It's simple and easy to play, more so than some other match 3 games. I don't like the fact that you're automatically entered into competitions that require you to collect things when the punishment for not collecting enough is demotion through the ranks. At least give the option to opt in, because you don't always have the time to play. Also, 3hrs unlimited energy is excessive.

This game is fun and addicting. But the level designs need to be looked over because there are so many that I got stuck on for days at a time. I'm getting tired or the repetitive nature of me continuously losing no matter what I do. I guess if I used real money in this game I can go through the levels with ease, but then that means this is a money grabbing game. 😞 Really game designers, you couldn't have done the levels less frustrating?

I like this as a match 3 game, and enjoy building my garden, but the ads suggest that it is a very different style of game. At no point do you solve any problems. Even with the choices you have, they are limited to decorating the garden, and sometimes I do not like the options provided by Austin's taste in landscape architecture. The advertising is really misleading.

Levels are ridiculously hard to pass without purchasing extra lives or power ups and it takes dozens or more attempts to finally gain 1 point when 3pts are required for most tasks, some of which are totally pointless. Far too few moves make it virtually impossible to pass each level. one of the most frustrating games I've played. You make it so difficult to make the most minute amount of progress that it is no longer fun, and I'm sure you lose many players for this reason. Dont install this game!

I can't give this game a terrible rating because it was very fun to play up until after the treehouse frame was built. Then it became virtually unplayable without pumping money into the game. I would rather either have ads in the game or pay a reasonable, one-time fee for a fun mobile game, rather than have a Kobayashi Maru scenario that is impossible to beat in order to force people to make in-game purchases. Like I said, still a good game and worth checking out.

I used to love it, but the further I go the harder it becomes. I mean, the hard levels are ridiculously hard unless you spend money, and even the easy levels take me too many goes! I never get past about 4 levels when we are trying to grow a flower or bonsai, and don't get me started on the dog training levels! I'm thinking about giving it up. I dont think one star is enough for each level because it takes so long to get ahead, and I can't afford to spend money. 😐

Love this game, have it over a year, nearly on level 2000. Updated it and the game has not worked properly since. Kept freezing each time I beat a level and would have to go out of the game and back in again to play each time. Had just under 4 hours of free play, alot of bombs etc. Have trouble shooted. Uninstalled the game and installed again and the game wont even start now. There is obviously a bug in the game. Help!! I want to keep playing!

Game is definately NOT as advertised. Not even anything close to what was advertised. Tried playing just to see if maybe the parts advertised were in some sort of bonus but no. I did end up enjoying the game and still play. But it was very mis leading. A suggestion for improved game play would be to have the infinity bonuses. (Eg unlimited lives for 30 min) be sent to your inbox, not just automatically applied. It's frustrating when you are ready to log off & you get a bonus like that. Wasted.

I play this game like 2 years now. At the beginning everything was fine, I was able to collect the stars, make a progress. Now I'm on 2346 lvl and the level of difficulty is so high that I will never in my life collect Halloween decorations from this year. Don't understand why you still sorting the levels for "normal" and "hard" if all of them now are extremely difficult. BTW now the "hard" levels are every 2-3 levels, sometimes 2 in a row. The game makes me annoyed much and few more days and I'm gonna delete it. I think it's time to move on.

It's just a standard matching game. The storyline is inconsistent and painfully slow, regardless of difficulty each level only earns 1 star (used to complete goals), it sends you back to the garden after each level instead of just letting you continue playing and you don't have any control over the garden you're supposed to be building, it's 100% dictated by your "butler" (who either did or did not work at the house before you lived there, depending on... who knows what). Weirdly good animation.

It's fun and aesthetically pleasing as you progress and provides a nice challenge. It is however a bit ridiculous sometimes. Having to get stars to look at a package, then another to open it, another to send it off...you sometimes just aren't motivated to get stars because you aren't seeing any progression, it feels like an awful filler episode in a good series. Other than that, good game for time wasting. Edit: Lowered my rating for false advertising. I used to play this game and find ads for it all over but they advertise something that certainly isn't Gardenscapes. If those ads get you more people installing, then create a game like that. Don't falsely advertise before you get taken to court for it.

The ads for this game involve escaping a bad situation. I finally downloaded it, it seemed interesting. But where the heck is that! It's a candy-crush-esque game with fixing up a house. I have 0 interest in that. I wanted to solve the puzzle of the escape part. I've been playing for like 2 hours now (in total) and I still haven't gotten to any escaping. Uninstalling. Edit, because I can't reply your reply: It's not even a general idea. It's false advertising. No. Make the ad game instead.

The first thing you should know it that this is really not a relaxing game at all. If I had to pick one word, it would be Frustrating. The second thing is the characters of the woman and child you see in the ads actually barely feature, and instead of renovating the garden (the part I was actually interested in) you have to spend almost all of your time doing crazy random fruit-machine levels. The levels quickly become hard (or impossible) and you can't skip, or watch an ad.

Picked this up last week. Really enjoyed it. Challenging but not stupid. The story is cute. Gave this game 5 stars.  Now, only 1.  This is a GOOD FUN CHALLENGING game but it is really just a glorified cash grab.  The rewards you receive are not enough to keep playing without spending money.  The coins you receive for beating each level are not nearly enough to keep purchasing bombs, gloves, rakes, dynamite, etc.  and again, you're spending money.  You need the extras in order to beat the hard levels and you definitely need them for the super hard levels.  Then there are the regular levels that have the honey, the hard honey, the honey pots, the carpets (or whatever they're supposed to be).  You get no warning they're coming up in the next level unless they're part of a 'goal'.  You need to be pretty much 'perfect' in order to beat these levels without any extras.  As for the 'Cash' to purchase the extras, why?  They don't add anything to the game play.  You get no reward for it and honestly, I've found the majority of them to be useless to the garden I've created.  I'm on level 429.  I've spent the last dime on this game that I'm willing to spend.  Too bad I won't finish the game.

Lovely graphics and fun to interact with. Very frustrating if you don't want to spend money as it's hard to earn boosters and lives, you just have to wait for the game to gift them to you.. this isn't something they build you up to either, I've spent plenty of money on app games before but with this there's no "grace period" to get into the game first like most games have and it's really put me off. Wish the "pay 900 coins to keep playing" screen came with an "Are you sure?" option as coins take forever to build up and if you press that button by accident in a game you have no hope of winning and can make you wanna throw your phone out the window 😅 The occasional unlimited lives for 30mins that they send you are brilliant though!

I play this game for ages now. I like it - it's the only match 3 games that stuck with me. I like all the events, and the design of the game. I would say that sometimes it's hard to pass the level without help - sad but true. Especially if you want to progress on the game smoothly and/of get all the event prizes. Also, it's a bit discouraging to see how many stars you need sometimes to progress in the garden decor. It keeps increasing with each area.

The game itself is great. I especially like the visuals in the garden and the cute story. However after only a short while the levels become excruciatingly hard. In fact so hard that you are almost forced to buy boosts and/or retrys. And it's not like buying a premium account for an adequate price. You'd have to pay after every few levels. If you are not ready to pay unhealthy sums it becomes unplayable after just enough time to make you addicted. Stay away from this!

Been playing for about 2 weeks, and it's not the game, it is portrayed to be. I was hoping to help characters get out of situations. Instead I am playing a version of candy crush. The game is slow moving, and the rewards are not enough to continue play, and beat the tough challenges. There is also so many competition s going on, it is just too much. Super disappointed it was not the advertised game, that I was constantly seeing. Removing it.

Didn't read reviews before downloading, I'm going through a difficult time and have turned to gaming to try and take my mind off things, I found this game advertised through another. Downloaded it after seeing the contact several times and finally getting sucked into thinking it looked fun. When you loose control in your own life, I thought it would be fun to gain control in another way, but gameplay is not what was advertised. It's a candy crush style game with some gardening stuff in between.

I've uninstalled this twice now, having come back to it a second time to see if it had improved. It was fun to start with, but the levels get difficult to complete without having to buy loads of coins or boosters. Such a frustrating game. Also, not as advertised - the main game is only a match-three game, and the rest is collecting coins / items in the main game to improve the garden etc. I don't know how they get away with the adverts they use, these aren't in the game (as far as I've seen).

It's good for what it is. But, as someone who played the two original Gardenscapes I miss the hidden object portion. That was one of the things I loved most about it. I've played this game since the beginning and will probably continue to play. I love the decorating and restoring aspects and the graphics are great. I do wish that some things didn't need to use stars. Why use 2 stars to call someone when I've called them without using stars before? Also some of the side quests that require stars are frivolous and have nothing to do with restoring the garden. The only other thing I'll say is that I think the majority of decisions should have options not just 60-75%.

A great game, but needs some variety in the levels, when you reach higher levels. They start to feel the same, when the same mechanics continues trough ten levels in a row or so. Also, after level 1000 and now 2000 it becomes fewer different types of games. It looses some of the fun. It's not in this game.  Now, to rate this game for what it is.  You play as the owner of a garden with a butler.  By solving "match-3" candy crush puzzles you win stars which you can use to repair and beautify your own garden.  If you like match-3 and want to have your own garden, maybe you'll like this game.  Pros:  * You can choose your own furniture, mailboxes, etc. * Colorful graphics and smooth gameplay  Neutral:  * Maybe you will like the butler, maybe not.  He interacts with you.  "It's all thanks to you, Tom!"  Or "Tom, look at the squirrels!"  I personally didn't like the butler.  He talked too much, and I felt like he was treating me as a kid or as a very close friend, not as his boss.  * The tutorials / hand-holding were annoying because they constantly interrupted the game  Cons:  * You cannot choose where to put your furniture, mailboxes, etc.  You can only choose what they look like * No undo button.  If you accidentally make a wrong move, you're stuck with it
